以[内容主体]为核心，生成一张具有作品集封面秩序感的视觉作品，画幅比例 9:10。整体概念改为：被水雾覆盖的镜面上，擦出一条干净、清晰、克制的窄窗，观者只能通过这条窄窗进入主题，其余信息都被镜面雾气、凝结水珠、轻微折射与朦胧失焦有意识地隐藏。

主体不要完整陈列，不要正中对称展示，而是先被压缩成一个偏离中轴的主质量，沉入低饱和、低对比的背景场与半透明雾面之下。主体的大部分轮廓、次要细节和普通说明信息，都被镜面水雾、凝露颗粒、擦拭残痕、细小折射位移、乳白模糊与暗部吞没；只在最能承载主题识别的位置，擦出一条狭长、精准、边缘清晰的窄窗，像手指或布料刚刚从雾面镜子上抹开的痕迹。这个窄窗尺寸克制，但语义必须准确，是画面中唯一强识别入口。窄窗内部保留真实质感、较高对比、必要色彩与清晰细节，其余部分则退回为暗部质量、柔化轮廓、破碎边缘和被背景吃掉的过渡。

如果主题适合加入轻微私密感，可以通过成年人日常私域线索来表达，例如：靠近镜面的呼吸痕迹、指尖擦拭留下的路径、模糊的人体侧影、肩颈或锁骨附近的轮廓、贴近镜面的手部局部、残留水汽中的体温感、浴室或更衣空间的含蓄暗示、个人物件的近距离痕迹等；但整体必须保持克制、艺术化、非低俗、非裸露、非露骨、不过界，只传达人与空间之间的微妙亲密感与现实温度，而不是情色叙事。

背景不承担普通场景叙事，而是由主题的空间关系、材料属性、时间方向与情绪温度推导为大面积、低噪声、低饱和的色场。上部或外侧保留轻微空气感，一侧形成淡色呼吸区，主体所在区域压入更低明度。背景的任务是：吞没边缘、承载文字、制造距离感、留住记忆感。整体色彩维持稳定结构：大面积低饱和结构色 + 低明度主体色 + 少量集中真实色 + 白色信息色。色相可随[内容主体]变化，但明度层级、饱和度克制与局部色彩价值必须稳定。

画面采用三层清晰度结构：

清晰层：仅限镜面水雾中被擦开的窄窗，用于主题识别；
半清晰层：用于粗白标题、编号、少量关键信息，保持可读但略带雾面咬边；
失焦层：主体大部分、背景、底部微型注释与边缘信息，进入雾化、失焦和材料遮蔽之中。

文字系统采用现代无衬线字体，白色或近白。标题要短促、厚重、克制，像印在起雾镜面上，又被潮湿表层轻微咬边；角落标识、边缘日期、编号、档案标签、底部微型注释共同构成一个技术档案式元数据坐标系，像作品编号、记录标签或制作参数。文字必须服务于阅读路径，不能压住清晰窄窗，也不能破坏主体识别入口。

整体表面必须统一覆盖一种真实可见的镜面水雾质感：
可见凝结水珠、细小雾滴、擦拭痕、轻微手印路径、局部清洁痕与边缘折射。暗部区域雾滴密度更高，亮部更乳白，边缘可出现细碎折射、轻微错位和玻璃感偏移。所有图像、对象和文字都像被同一层带水汽的镜面材料压在下面，形成统一表面逻辑。
整体气质应呈现：冷静、克制、现代、带技术档案感、轻微私密、具有人性温度但不过界的视觉封面。信息被有意识地隐藏，只有最关键的局部被释放；像一次擦开水雾后的短暂注视，既有距离，也有真实。

明确约束：

不要完整直白地展示主体；

不要普通海报式陈列；
不要高饱和、花哨装饰或强叙事背景；
不要露骨性暗示、裸露敏感部位、低俗表达或违规内容；
不要让文字遮挡清晰窄窗；
保持高级、安静、克制、可作为作品集封面使用。

【核心主题】
活动主题：[活动主题]

副标题：[活动副标题 / 主题语]

【整体视觉气质】
清楚、克制、潮湿、冷静、图形化、低噪声、高明度、强设计感。
画面像一张印刷完成的活动海报，又像隔着一层湿润透明介质被重新观看。
整体不能像商业科技模板、不能像普通活动背景板、不能像复杂插画。

【画面结构】
采用严格的 16:9 横版构图。
画面内部由一条强轴线组织视觉阅读路径，轴线可以是偏左垂直轴、轻微斜向轴或横向测量轴，但必须清晰。
中部形成最密集的主题识别核心，主体边缘、下部或侧边被画幅裁断，保留画外延展感。
不要使用竖版海报构图，不要使用中心对称广告构图，不要平均铺满画面。

【主体处理】
将活动主题转译为一个低细节、高识别的抽象主体。
主体不能完整写实呈现，而要被压缩成：
1. 暗色骨架
2. 负形空洞
3. 局部识别边缘
4. 少量低明度质量块
5. 断续轮廓方向
6. 被裁切的结构片段

主体必须像从大面积高明度主场内部显影出来，而不是贴在背景上。
主体边缘必须被透明介质切过，形成轻微断续、弯折、漂浮、遮挡、折射和被吞没的感觉。
主体细节保持低密度，只保留主题识别所需的最少结构信息。

【场域与背景】
背景不是装饰纹理，而是由活动主题自身推导出的可见介质场。
建立一个大面积高明度、低噪声的主场，占画面面积的 70% 到 82%。
主场必须穿过主体、文字和空白区域，形成统一的空间层。

背景介质包含：
- 透明覆盖层
- 湿润表面反射
- 青白色轻高光
- 轻微扫描颗粒
- 柔和细折痕
- 不同尺度的场域扰动
- 局部折射弧线
- 被软化的暗色边缘

这些扰动必须跨越主体、文字和空白，不允许只停留在背景上。

【色彩比例】
使用严格的色彩层级：
- 高明度主色：70% 到 82%，用于主场
- 低明度结构色：10% 到 18%，用于主体、细线、标签、骨架

- 高能注记色：小于 1%，全画面只能出现一次

辅助文字高度控制在画面高度的 1.2% 到 2.5%。
文字集中贴近强轴线、边界线或底部信息带。

【信息节点】
在一个关键小信息节点放入唯一的高能色注记。

画面具有平面印刷质感，但被湿润透明表面重新观看。

text:
[BRAND NAME] | [HEADLINE = user text or AUTO] | [SUBHEADLINE = user text or AUTO] | [BUTTON TEXT = user text or AUTO] | [COLOR = your color or AUTO]

Act as a Senior Web Art Director and CGI Artist creating a photorealistic hero section of a premium brand website — a single wide-format image showing the full above-the-fold view of a hero webpage. The composition combines a dramatic 3D sculptural logo object with editorial typography and minimal UI elements. References: Stökt agency website, Apple product launch pages, high-end creative agency hero sections, Awwwards-winning website design.

---

PHASE 0: BRAND INTELLIGENCE — AUTONOMOUS EXTRACTION

Perform a complete brand decode of [BRAND NAME] from training data before generating anything. Every visual decision in the image is derived from this phase.

COLOR SYSTEM — PRIMARY COLOR DETERMINATION: if [COLOR] is provided by the user — use that exact color as the primary driver for the entire image color system. Do not override it with brand colors. If [COLOR] is AUTO — identify the exact primary brand color of [BRAND NAME] from their official guidelines — the single most iconic, most documented color associated with the brand. In both cases: this one color drives the entire image's color system — background gradient, 3D object material, atmospheric lighting, all derived from this single color.

BACKGROUND GRADIENT DERIVATION: from the determined primary color derive exactly two gradient stops. Inner stop: the most saturated vivid version of the primary color at full intensity — this is the atmospheric glow behind the object. Outer stop: the darkest possible version of the same hue — near black but with a visible trace of the color's hue remaining (#0A to #12 lightness range). Both stops are derived exclusively from the primary color. No neutral black. No grey. The darkness has color in it — it is a very dark tinted black, not a neutral one. Examples: red primary → inner #CC0000, outer #1A0000. Green primary → inner #1DB954, outer #001A0A. Blue primary → inner #0057FF, outer #00060F. Orange primary → inner #FF6600, outer #1A0500.

3D OBJECT MATERIAL DERIVATION: from the primary color derive the metal material — base/shadow color: the darkest near-black version of the color hue (same as gradient outer stop). Highlight color: the most vivid saturated version of the color (same as gradient inner stop), appearing on edges and high points facing the light source. Mid-tone: a medium value of the color on surfaces at 45° to the light. The entire metal object is one color family — dark in shadow, vivid and bright in highlight, all derived from the same hue. No neutral grey metal. No silver. The metal has the brand or user color in its DNA.

TYPOGRAPHY: identify [BRAND NAME]'s official typeface character — the visual weight, width, and style used in their brand communications. Apply consistently to all text elements.

BRAND SYMBOL: identify the single most iconic reduced form of [BRAND NAME]'s logo — the symbol, monogram, or letterform most recognizable as the brand. This becomes the 3D sculptural object. If [BRAND NAME] has no standalone symbol — use the first letter of the wordmark as the 3D form.

BRAND LANGUAGE: if [HEADLINE] is AUTO — extract the most powerful real brand statement or campaign headline associated with [BRAND NAME]. If [SUBHEADLINE] is AUTO — extract a real brand descriptor sentence describing what [BRAND NAME] does or stands for. If [BUTTON TEXT] is AUTO — identify the primary CTA phrase [BRAND NAME] uses in their marketing. If any variable has user-provided text — use that exact text, do not override it.

FOUNDING INFORMATION: extract [BRAND NAME]'s founding year for the bottom corner attribution.

---

PHASE 1: BACKGROUND

Full-bleed background filling the entire image. A radial gradient emanating from the center-right zone where the 3D object sits — not a flat color, not a linear gradient, a circular atmospheric glow. Inner zone: the saturated vivid color derived in PHASE 0 — deep, rich, atmospheric, occupying approximately 40 to 50% of the total background area. Outer zone: the very dark tinted black derived in PHASE 0 — envelops the composition at all edges. The transition is soft and organic — a gradual atmospheric fade, not a hard edge. The gradient creates the sensation of a warm spotlight behind and to the right of the 3D object — as if the object itself is the source of this atmospheric light.

---

PHASE 2: 3D LOGO SCULPTURE — HERO ELEMENT

The brand symbol from PHASE 0 rendered as a massive three-dimensional sculptural object. Occupies the right 55 to 65% of total image width — monumental, partially cropped by the right and bottom frame edges. The cropping is deliberate — we see most but not all of the object, implying it extends beyond the frame. Rotated approximately 20 to 35° on the vertical axis and 10 to 20° on the horizontal axis — a dynamic three-quarter view revealing multiple faces simultaneously. Camera angle: 5 to 10° below center — adds imposing low-angle presence.

MATERIAL SYSTEM — DERIVED FROM PRIMARY COLOR: the object is premium dark brushed metal. All material colors derived exclusively from the primary color as determined in PHASE 0. Base/shadow color: very dark near-black color-tinted metal on faces away from the light. Brushed texture: fine parallel directional micro-scratches on each face following the face geometry — industrial brushed metal quality. Highlight zones: faces angled toward the primary light source catch the vivid saturated color as warm bright highlights — ranging from mid-tone color to near-white at absolute specular peaks. Edge highlights: every sharp edge of the object catches a thin continuous bright specular line tracing the full logo geometry — this edge glow defines the form against the background. The contrast between near-black shadowed faces and bright vivid-colored highlighted edges is the defining visual characteristic. Scale feel: monumental — as if 3 to 5 meters tall in physical space.

---

PHASE 3: NAVIGATION BAR

Minimal navbar at the very top — height approximately 4 to 5% of total image height. Background: very dark semi-transparent — the tinted dark color from PHASE 0 at 85 to 90% opacity. Left: [BRAND NAME] wordmark or logomark in correct official form, small white type. Center: 4 to 6 navigation categories in small all-caps tracked white type — autonomously determine relevant categories based on [BRAND NAME]'s business. Right: language switcher pill and primary CTA button — dark background, light border, small caps "[BUTTON TEXT]" with right arrow →. All navbar elements small, precise, minimal — do not compete with hero elements.

---

PHASE 4: TEXT BLOCK — LEFT SIDE

Positioned in the left 35 to 40% of the image, vertically centered, left-aligned with appropriate margin. The left side is in the darker zone of the background gradient — white text is fully legible without additional treatment.

Label line: small bracketed label above the headline — "{ WE ARE [BRAND NAME] } →" or brand-appropriate equivalent. Very small type, white, tracked out, thin weight.

Headline: [HEADLINE] — set in [BRAND NAME]'s typographic character, bold, uppercase or sentence case per brand convention. Large — approximately 8 to 10% of total image height per line. White. Two to three lines maximum. Left-aligned.

Body copy: [SUBHEADLINE] — one to two sentences, small regular weight, white at 70 to 80% opacity. Below headline with appropriate spacing. Maximum 35 to 40 characters per line.

CTA buttons: two side-by-side buttons. Primary: dark fill, white border, white text "[BUTTON TEXT]" with right arrow →. Secondary: outline only, white border, white text with secondary action autonomously determined from [BRAND NAME]'s context. Both buttons small and minimal — slightly rounded rectangle, small caps type.

---

PHASE 5: BOTTOM ELEMENTS

Bottom left: "Scroll for more ↓" in very small white type — 2 to 3% of image height, subtle.

Bottom right: "Est. in [FOUNDING YEAR]" in very small white type — founding year from PHASE 0, same scale.

---

PHASE 6: LIGHTING

Single primary light source: warm dramatic light positioned behind and to the upper right of the 3D object. Light color: the vivid saturated primary color from PHASE 0 — it is the color expressed as atmospheric light, consistent with the gradient inner stop. This light creates both the background radial glow and the warm highlights on the metal object — they are the same light, the same color, the same source. Secondary ambient: very subtle cool ambient from directly above — 5% intensity, barely lifts the absolute darkest shadow zones. No fill lights. No rim lights. The dramatic contrast between lit and unlit faces is intentional and must be preserved.

---

PHASE 7: COMPOSITION

Aspect ratio: 16:9 landscape — website hero section proportions. Left 35 to 40%: text zone (darker background, UI elements). Right 60 to 65%: 3D sculpture zone (object dominates). Text block and object do not overlap — clear spatial separation. Reading direction: text left → sculpture right.

---

PHASE 8: TECH SPECS

Render: Octane Render or Redshift — physically accurate brushed metal with correct anisotropic highlight behavior. All material colors derived from the primary color as determined in PHASE 0 — no neutral greys, no off-color elements anywhere in the image. If [COLOR] was user-provided — that color overrides any brand color in all material and lighting calculations. Ray tracing: on — for accurate edge highlights and metal inter-reflections. Background gradient: physically accurate radial atmospheric light — real volumetric light contribution, not a composited gradient overlay. Typography: crisp, anti-aliased, flat white — zero shadows, zero blur, zero effects. UI elements: clean flat design, no drop shadows, no gradients on UI elements. Color palette: exclusively the color system derived in PHASE 0 plus white for text — no additional colors introduced anywhere. Sampling: minimum 2048 samples. Anti-aliasing: maximum. Output feel: the actual above-the-fold screenshot of [BRAND NAME]'s relaunched premium website — Awwwards front page quality.

【核心目标】
这次要设计的是一个真正可商用的「国风美食角色徽章 Logo」。它不是普通卡通插画，不是简单餐饮海报，也不是单纯文字 Logo，而是一个以“国潮人物角色 + 醒目中文招牌字标 + 餐饮品类说明 + 徽章式整合结构”为核心的餐饮品牌标志。

整体要让人一眼感受到：这是一个有角色、有食欲、有店铺感、有包装感、适合真实餐饮品牌使用的 Logo。它既可以作为门店招牌，也可以用于外卖头像、包装贴纸、餐盒、杯身、菜单、社媒头像和食品包装正面主视觉。

【设计本质】
这类 Logo 的重点不是单独画一个可爱人物，而是把以下三层整合为一个完整品牌标志：

1. 角色层：负责吸引注意力和品牌人格；
2. 字标层：负责品牌名识别和传播；
3. 徽章层：负责把角色、文字和品类信息整合成一个完整 Logo 单位。

最终效果应像一个成熟的国潮餐饮品牌 Logo，而不是散乱的插画加文字。

【最重要的原则】
1. 这必须首先是一个 Logo，而不是一张插画海报。
2. 角色要有记忆点，但不能压过品牌名。
3. 中文品牌名字标必须醒目、清楚、有招牌感。
4. 整体必须有餐饮消费感、食欲感和包装识别度。
5. 角色、食物、文字、徽章结构必须是一个整体，而不是简单拼贴。
6. 风格要国潮、有趣、有亲和力，但不能廉价、低幼或过度杂乱。文字不要过于密集。

【角色设计要求】
请根据【角色设定】设计一个具有品牌人格的国潮美食角色。

角色设计要求：
1. 角色形象要有明显记忆点；
2. 表情要亲和、有食欲感、有烟火气；
3. 动作要和食物或品类有关，例如端碗、举串、喝奶茶、揉面、炒锅、拿勺、举招牌等；
4. 服装可以带有国风、地域、民俗或餐饮职业特征；
5. 角色应偏品牌 IP 化，不要写实，不要过度复杂；
6. 角色要适合缩小后仍能识别，适合做品牌头像和包装图案。

【食物元素要求】
请围绕【食物元素】加入少量但准确的餐饮符号，例如：
- 碗、锅、筷子、勺子、蒸汽
- 火焰、炭火、辣椒、汤汁
- 奶茶杯、吸管、茶叶、冰块
- 糕点、汤圆、肉丸、面条、串串
- 地域食材、调味料、包装纸、餐盒

食物元素要服务品牌识别，不要堆砌。  
重点是让观众一眼知道这个品牌大概卖什么。

【字标设计要求】
品牌名是 Logo 的核心识别之一，必须清楚、醒目、有招牌感。

中文品牌名字标应具有：
1. 粗壮、有力、饱满的餐饮招牌感；
2. 适度国潮风、复古包装感或卡通字感；
3. 可加入描边、阴影、底托、牌匾、圆角、厚度感；
4. 字体可以略微夸张，但必须可读；
5. 不要太极简，不要像普通系统字体；
6. 字标要和角色风格统一。

【徽章结构要求】
请将角色、品牌名、品类信息整合成完整徽章式 Logo。

可选择以下结构之一：
1. 上方角色 + 下方中文大字标；
2. 角色站在食物或器具上 + 字标作为底托；
3. 圆形 / 椭圆 / 牌匾式徽章结构；
4. 左右对称小牌 + 中央角色；
5. 角色与文字交叠成一个完整品牌章；
6. 底部横向招牌条 + 上方角色 IP；
7. 外卖头像式圆章 / 包装贴纸式结构。

整体应像一个可直接用于食品包装、门店招牌或社媒头像的完整 Logo。

【辅助信息要求】
可以加入少量辅助文字和小标识，例如：
- 品类说明
- 英文副标题
- 创立年份
- 地域标签
- “手作”“现做”“老味道”“秘制”等小字
- 小圆章、小边框、小装饰条

但辅助信息必须克制，不能让画面变成复杂海报。

【风格方向要求】
整体应呈现：
- 国潮感
- 餐饮感
- 包装感
- 角色 IP 感
- 亲和力
- 传播感
- 食欲感
- 地方小吃 / 新消费餐饮品牌气质

整体必须避免：
- 低幼儿童插画感
- 过度复杂海报感
- 纯插画而不像 Logo
- 人物太写实
- 字体太弱
- 颜色太脏太杂
- 信息堆太多
- 缺少餐饮品类识别

【色彩要求】
请根据【主色调】和【辅助色】设计整体配色。

推荐色彩方向：
1. 烧烤 / 火锅 / 重口味：红、橙、黑、土黄、深棕；
2. 甜品 / 奶茶 / 糕点：粉、奶白、浅紫、豆沙红、杏色；
3. 地方小吃 / 面食 / 米线：米白、墨黑、朱红、青绿、土黄；
4. 海鲜 / 清爽食堂：蓝、青、白、红色小印章；
5. 老字号 / 熟食 / 酱料：棕红、暗金、墨黑、米黄。

颜色要有食欲感和品牌记忆点，但不要超过 4～5 个主要颜色。  
亮色点缀可以增强吸睛度，但不能喧宾夺主。

【画面呈现要求】
1. 画面为独立 Logo 展示图，不要做成复杂海报；
2. 背景简洁，推荐白底、米白底、浅灰底或低饱和纯色底；
3. Logo 主体居中，清晰完整；
4. 角色、字标、品类说明和徽章结构必须完整统一；
5. 整体看起来像真实餐饮品牌的 Logo 提案，而不是单张插画。

【验收标准】
请确保最终结果满足以下标准：
1. 一眼能看到品牌名；
2. 一眼能感受到卖什么；
3. 角色有记忆点；
4. 整体是完整 Logo，而不是插画海报；
5. 适合用于门店、包装、餐盒、贴纸、外卖头像和社媒头像；
6. 有国潮美食品牌的亲和力、食欲感和传播感。

【输出要求】
请最终输出一个高完成度的「国风美食角色徽章 Logo」。它必须首先是一个成熟、完整、可品牌化、可应用的餐饮 Logo；其次，它要通过国潮角色、醒目字标、食物元素和徽章结构，形成强识别、强亲和、强传播的美食品牌形象。

入力されたキャラクター画像をもとに、
そのキャラクターの「魅力解剖図」を1枚のビジュアルとして作成してください。

これは通常のキャラクター設定資料、三面図、プロフィールシートではありません。
目的は、キャラクターの情報を説明することではなく、
「この子のどこが可愛いのか」「なぜ目を惹かれるのか」「どの部分に好きになる理由があるのか」を、
デザイン的・感情的に分解して見せることです。

入力画像からキャラクターの以下の魅力要素を丁寧に読み取ってください。

・目の形、瞳の色、目線の印象
・髪の流れ、前髪、毛先、シルエットの可愛さ
・表情のクセ、微笑み方、照れ、無表情の中の感情
・手の仕草、指先、袖口との関係
・衣装の好きポイント、リボン、フリル、装飾、小物
・首元、肩、袖、スカート、靴などの見せ場
・そのキャラクターが一番かわいく見える角度
・全体から感じる性格、雰囲気、守りたくなるポイント、惹かれる理由

中央にはキャラクターを大きく配置してください。
キャラクターはただ立たせるのではなく、
その子の魅力が最も伝わる角度、ポーズ、表情で描いてください。
正面すぎる証明写真のような構図は禁止。
少し振り向く、手を口元に添える、袖をつまむ、髪を軽く押さえる、視線を少し外すなど、
“好きになる瞬間”を切り取ったような自然で魅力的なポーズにしてください。

周囲には、キャラクターの魅力ポイントを分解した小さなクローズアップパネルを配置してください。
ただし機械的な設定資料のように並べるのではなく、
雑誌の特集ページ、デザイン解剖図、ファンが作った愛のある分析ボードのように、
美しく、可愛く、少し偏愛を感じるレイアウトにしてください。

配置するパネル例：
・瞳のアップ：この子らしさが宿る目元
・髪の流れ：シルエットを決める毛束
・手元：仕草に出る性格
・表情差分：微笑み、照れ、少し不機嫌、無防備な顔
・衣装の推しポイント：リボン、袖、襟、装飾、素材感
・一番かわいい角度：顔の向き、視線、首の傾き
・小物やモチーフ：その子の世界観を象徴する要素

各パネルは、キャラクターの魅力を強調するための拡大カットとして描いてください。
パーツだけを無機質に切り抜くのではなく、
「ここが好き」と思わせるような温度感のある見せ方にしてください。

画面内には短い注釈風のラベルを入れてもよいですが、
長文説明ではなく、短い見出しや記号的なデザインにしてください。
例：
“eyes”
“hair flow”
“gesture”
“best angle”
“favorite detail”
“charm point”
“soft expression”
“tiny habit”

文字は主役にしすぎず、あくまでデザイン要素として扱ってください。
読ませる資料ではなく、見た瞬間に「この子、可愛い」と伝わるビジュアルにしてください。

デザイン全体は、可愛い研究ノート、キャラクター愛の解剖図、ファッション誌の分析ページ、公式アートブックの特集ページを合わせたような雰囲気。
背景はシンプルで清潔感があり、キャラクターの色に合わせた淡いグラデーション、紙面風の余白、細い罫線、半透明のパネル、手書き風の丸囲み、矢印、ハート、小さな装飾を使ってください。

重要：
キャラクターを単に説明しないこと。
身長、年齢、能力、所属、武器説明などの設定資料的な情報は不要です。
描くべきなのはスペックではなく、
“好きになる理由”です。

キャラクター本人の魅力が最優先。
パネルや注釈が多すぎて主役が埋もれないようにしてください。
中央のキャラクターは必ず最も可愛く、最も完成度高く描いてください。

④ 3套 Look 展示区 / 3-Look Styling Plan
这是整张图的绝对核心，请占据最大视觉权重。

请明确展示 3 套完整造型，并按以下逻辑组织：

Look 01：主视觉 Look / Hero Look
- 这是整套方案的核心主视觉，视觉权重最大
- 要最大程度承载主题灵感，最完整、最鲜明、最有记忆点
- 造型应更完整、更强烈、更能体现风格表达
- 画面中人物展示应最大、最抓人

Look 02：上班 Look / Work Look
- 保留主题的核心气质与色彩逻辑
- 但整体更加日常、克制、实穿
- 适合通勤、工作、日常城市场景
- 强调利落、舒服、可落地

Look 03：约会 Look / Date Look
- 保留主题风格，但比 Work Look 更精致、更柔和、更有氛围感
- 适合约会、聚会、展览、轻社交等场景
- 强调女性魅力、细节感、氛围感与气质提升

三套 Look 不要做得像三套毫无关系的搭配，而必须保持统一主题下的系列感。

PHASE 0: BRAND INTELLIGENCE — AUTONOMOUS RESEARCH

Before generating any visual, perform a complete brand decode of [BRAND NAME] from training data. Extract and apply all of the following autonomously:

Color system: identify the exact primary and secondary brand colors — their specific hex values, how they are used in hierarchy (dominant background color, accent color, text color). These colors drive every card in the grid.

Typography DNA: identify the exact typeface or typeface category [BRAND NAME] uses — serif, sans-serif, condensed, extended, grotesque, slab. Identify the weight hierarchy: what weight is used for headlines, what for body text, what for labels. Apply this typography system throughout all four cards.

Brand language: identify the tone of voice, key phrases, campaign slogans, product categories, founding year, key collaborators, cultural positioning. Extract real factual information about [BRAND NAME] that can be used as text content across the four cards — real product names, real campaign titles, real dates, real locations, real brand statements.

Visual codes: identify the photographic style associated with [BRAND NAME] — editorial fashion, sport, street, luxury, industrial. Identify compositional patterns the brand uses — full bleed photography, text-dominant layouts, graphic-only compositions, collage.

All text content across all four cards must be real information about [BRAND NAME] — not placeholder text, not generic copy. Real brand slogans, real product lines, real campaign names, real founding information.

---

PHASE 1: GRID SYSTEM

The output is a single image composed of four equal rectangular cards arranged in a 2×2 grid. Total image dimensions: square or slightly landscape — 1:1 or 4:3 ratio. Each card is identical in size — exactly one quarter of the total image area. A thin gap of 4 to 6px between cards — neutral dark or light depending on brand palette. The four cards form a unified editorial system — they share the same color palette and typography but each has a distinct layout typology. Together they tell the brand story.

---

PHASE 2: CARD 1 — HERO EDITORIAL (top left)

Layout typology: large bold typography layered over or integrated with photography. Dominant background color: [BRAND NAME]'s primary brand color at full saturation — fills the entire card. Photography: a fashion or lifestyle image relevant to [BRAND NAME]'s visual world — model, product, or environment. The photo is either full-bleed behind the text or cropped into a specific zone of the card with text occupying the remaining space. Photo treatment: slight blend mode integration with the background color — the photo and background feel like one unified surface. Typography: the most recognizable [BRAND NAME] headline or slogan in the largest type size on the card — bold condensed, uppercase, white or brand secondary color. The text is large enough to partially overlap the photo. Secondary small text: brand name, location, date — set in small caps or tracking-heavy small type in a corner. The overall feeling: a magazine cover or campaign poster.

---

PHASE 3: CARD 2 — EDITORIAL TEXT LAYOUT (top right)

Layout typology: text-dominant editorial layout with a small photo inset. Background: [BRAND NAME]'s secondary brand color or a dark neutral consistent with the brand palette. Large headline: a real [BRAND NAME] campaign title or brand statement broken across multiple lines — each line a different size or weight, creating a typographic staircase effect. The largest line is very large, the smallest is medium, they are left-aligned creating a ragged right edge. Small body text column: a real paragraph of brand information — founding story, product description, or campaign context — set in small regular weight type, positioned in the upper right or lower right of the card. Photo inset: a small rectangular photo — 20 to 30% of card area — positioned where it interrupts or overlaps the headline text, creating editorial tension. The photo has a colored border or frame in the brand primary color.

---

PHASE 4: CARD 3 — FASHION EDITORIAL (bottom left)

Layout typology: photography-forward with typography as structural background element. Photography: a strong fashion or product image — model wearing [BRAND NAME] product, or a key product hero shot. The photo is positioned in the left 50 to 60% of the card, cropped tightly. Photo treatment: slightly desaturated or high contrast — editorial black and white or brand-tinted. Background typography: behind and around the photo, a very large single word or letterform from [BRAND NAME]'s identity — set at 200 to 300% of the card height, in the brand primary or secondary color, acting as graphic wallpaper behind the photo. This background type is partially obscured by the photo. Body text: a column of real [BRAND NAME] editorial copy — 3 to 5 short paragraphs, small regular weight, positioned to the right of the photo. Pull quote: one sentence extracted from the body copy, set larger and in brand accent color, positioned between the photo and the body text.

---

PHASE 5: CARD 4 — CLEAN BRAND STATEMENT (bottom right)

Layout typology: minimal, graphic, brand identity statement. Background: white, off-white, or the lightest tone in [BRAND NAME]'s palette — maximum contrast with the other three cards. Primary element: [BRAND NAME]'s wordmark or brand name set in massive type — ultra-bold, condensed or extended depending on the brand's typographic DNA. The wordmark is broken across 2 to 3 lines, each line flush left, occupying 70 to 80% of the card width. Type color: black or the darkest brand color — maximum contrast on the light background. Secondary element: a model or product image positioned at the right edge of the card, slightly cropped — human presence that grounds the graphic layout. The model/product is not the focus — the typography is. Accent element: a year, a number, a collection identifier, or a brand slogan set small in the brand primary color — positioned as a superscript or footnote near the main wordmark, adding a handwritten or stamped quality.

---

PHASE 6: UNIFIED VISUAL SYSTEM

Typography consistency across all four cards: all type is set in typefaces consistent with [BRAND NAME]'s identity. Headline type: one typeface, one weight — the boldest, most brand-representative option. Body type: one typeface, regular weight — legible at small sizes. No decorative or unrelated typefaces. Color consistency: only the colors identified in PHASE 0 appear across all four cards — primary brand color, secondary brand color, neutral (white or black), and one accent. No colors outside this palette. No gradients. No drop shadows. No textures on type. Information consistency: all text is real [BRAND NAME] information. No lorem ipsum. No generic placeholder text. Every word on every card is either the brand name, a real product name, a real campaign title, a real date, a real location, or a real brand statement. Grid alignment: elements across cards share implied alignment axes — a headline that starts at a certain x-position in card 1 aligns with an element in card 3 at the same x-position. This creates visual cohesion across the 2×2 grid when viewed as a whole.

---

PHASE 7: TECH SPECS

Output: a single flat image of the complete 2×2 grid. No separate files. Aspect ratio: 1:1 square or 4:3 landscape. Total resolution feel: high enough to read all body text clearly. Typography rendering: all type anti-aliased and crisp — no blurry text. Photography: editorial quality, not stock photography aesthetic. Color accuracy: brand colors exactly as identified in PHASE 0 — not approximated. No film grain unless it is a brand-authentic texture. No vignettes. No lens flare. Clean, precise, editorial. Output feel: this moodboard could be published on Hypebeast, Highsnobiety, or used as an internal brand presentation deck slide.

【核心目标】
这次要设计的是一个真正的 logo，一个以文字为主体的复古标题字标标志，整体必须优先体现“logo设计”的属性：独立、清晰、可识别、可单独成立、具有品牌标志感。

同时，这个logo不能只是普通字形变化后的纯字标，而应在保持logo属性的前提下，加入适量的装饰性线条、辅助形状、局部填充和图案化处理，让它更有“复古标题型”的风格味道、精致度和视觉记忆点。

【最重要的原则】
1. 复古感必须主要来自字形设计、笔画风格、结构比例、装饰逻辑和局部图案化处理，而不是来自旧纸材质、做旧效果、海报背景或贴纸边框。
2. 可以增强装饰性，但不能失去logo的独立性与识别性。
3. 所有辅助元素必须服务于logo本体，不能把结果做成贴纸、标签、票券或海报页面。

【字标设计要求】
1. 以【品牌名 / 项目名】为绝对主视觉核心，设计成一个独立成立的字标logo。
2. 文字必须经过明显的定制化设计，不可直接使用普通电脑字体。
3. 请通过以下方式体现“复古标题感”：
   - 更有标题性的字形骨架
   - 更有年代感的笔画风格
   - 更有装饰意味但仍然清晰可识别的结构
   - 类似老招牌字、老片名字、老书封标题字、旧时代品牌字标的视觉语言
4. 可以适度融入复古风格的字体特征，例如：
   - 复古宋韵、旧黑体、老招牌体、装饰体、片名字感
   - 更鲜明的粗细对比
   - 更有标题感的比例和重心
   - 更有节奏感的笔画关系
5. 保持logo的可读性、识别度和整体性。

【风格强化层要求】
请在logo本体中加入适量“风格强化层”，但必须克制且服务于字标本身。可使用以下元素：

   - 对称辅助线

   - 小圆点
   - 小三角
   - 菱形

   - 笔画内部条纹填充
   - 局部黑白反转块面
   - 网点或细密线性填充
   - 装饰性切面
   - 局部图案纹样
   - 轻微雕版感的内部花纹
4. 局部图形强化：
   - 某些笔画可演变为复古装饰结构
   - 某些字内部可融合极简图案，但不能喧宾夺主
   - 让文字整体更像一个“被设计过的标题标志”，而不是单纯打字

【构成要求】
1. 主体必须是字标logo本身。
2. 可加入少量辅助内容，如：
   - 英文名
   - 拼音

   - 行业描述
   - slogan

4. 所有这些元素都应围绕logo本体组织，不能扩展成一整张复杂版面。
5. 不要使用大面积票券外框、标签轮廓、贴纸边缘、包装底板或夸张的装饰外形。

【画面呈现要求】
1. 画面应像“logo展示图 / logo提案页”，而不是海报。
2. 用简洁、干净、低存在感的背景展示logo。
3. 可以是白底、浅灰底、米白底等中性背景。
4. 画面重点是展示logo本体及其局部细节，而不是环境氛围。
5. 版式上可以有少量辅助说明，但整体必须集中服务于logo展示。

【色彩要求】
1. 以logo本体颜色为重点，而不是背景材质。
2. 可根据品牌属性使用【主色调】和【辅助色】。

5. 避免大面积旧纸、磨损、做旧噪点、脏污质感、夸张颗粒来制造风格。

logo优先、字标设计、wordmark、复古标题感、品牌标志、标题字、老招牌字、片名字感、装饰性线条、局部图案化、结构化填充、精致、独立、识别度高、可单独使用、精品化。

【验收标准】
如果去掉背景和辅助说明，这个字标本身仍然能独立成立为一个logo；同时它又具有明显的复古标题风格，而不是普通打字效果。

画面中央是一张自然展开的 古朴手工纸卷 / 宣纸长卷，纸张边缘略微卷起，带有岁月感与细腻做旧质感。左下角放置一支具有东方雅韵的 毛笔或羽毛笔，笔尖蘸着浓郁的青蓝色墨汁，墨色从笔尖自然流淌，在纸上形成一条蜿蜒灵动的 S 型珠江水脉。江水顺势流淌，在宣纸之上逐渐幻化、生长出一座精致的 微缩广州城景。

这座由笔墨生成的广州微缩世界，以 广州塔 作为最核心的视觉地标，沿着珠江展开，周围依次生长出 珠江新城现代天际线、猎德大桥、沿江建筑群、游船码头、珠江两岸城市肌理，并融合少量具有岭南风格的 骑楼、西关大屋、传统屋檐、临水街巷，形成“现代广州与岭南文脉共生”的视觉意境。城市由近至远层层展开，精致细腻，像是从墨迹里自然长出来的一幅山河城境图。

【创作目标】
这不是普通文字排版，不是复杂插画海报，也不是传统严肃企业 logo，而是一张具有强识别度、趣味感、亲和力、创意感与品牌感的「趣味图形 logo 展示图」。

请根据用户输入的信息，先判断这个品牌更适合哪一种趣味表达方向，再据此设计 logo：
1. 如果品牌更偏手作、轻文创、小店、咖啡、轻松随性气质，则偏向「手绘趣味型」；
2. 如果品牌更偏宠物、儿童、零食、IP、潮玩、可爱消费品，则偏向「卡通角色 / 动物型」；
3. 如果品牌更偏新消费、餐饮、生活方式、零售品牌，希望更简洁专业，则偏向「简约图形商业型」。

无论选择哪一种倾向，都必须保持在统一的「趣味图形 logo」体系内：简洁、好记、有创意、有亲和力、具有品牌识别性。

【核心视觉要求】
1. 以【品牌名】或【产品名】为灵感核心，提炼出一个具有品牌识别度的趣味图形 logo。
2. logo 应以“图形识别”为优先，不一定是纯文字 logo，也可以是文字与图形结合，或更偏符号化的图形标记。
3. 图形应围绕品牌属性展开，可结合产品特征、行业属性、名称联想、品牌个性进行创意转译。
4. 图形要简洁清晰，不要做成复杂插画；要像一个真正可用于品牌识别、包装、门头、社媒头像、周边物料的标志。
5. 整体气质要有趣、灵动、亲和、有记忆点，但不能幼稚杂乱，也不能太普通。
6. 如品牌适合角色化表达，可以融入动物、拟人、吉祥物、表情感、小角色感；如品牌更适合简洁表达，则收束为更几何、更规整的趣味图形语言。
7. 画面可以带轻微手绘感、卡通感或图形化感，但最终结果必须干净、成熟、统一。

【风格判断逻辑】
请根据输入信息，自动匹配最适合的表现方式：
- 偏温暖、手作、轻松、小而美：用手绘趣味图形语言
- 偏可爱、宠物、儿童、零食、角色化：用卡通角色 / 动物图形语言
- 偏现代、品牌化、商品化、商业应用：用简约图形商业语言
但不要在画面中直接写出“手绘趣味型 / 卡通型 / 商业型”这些分类词，只需要体现在最终视觉结果中。

【色彩要求】
1. 色彩应根据品牌属性自动匹配，整体保持趣味、明快、易识别。
2. 优先使用【主色调】和【辅助色】，可适当加入少量点缀色。
3. 色彩可以比中式意象 logo 更大胆，但不要杂乱，通常控制在 2–4 个主要颜色以内。
4. 可根据品牌气质决定是高明度清新、温暖可爱，还是低饱和趣味高级感。
5. 背景尽量简洁干净，可使用白色、米白、浅灰、浅彩底，以突出 logo 主体。

【结构与版式要求】
这张图是“logo 展示图”，而不是广告海报，请采用清晰、专业、可复用的展示结构：
- 主视觉区：放置 logo 主体，作为最大视觉中心
- 名称区：放置品牌名或产品名
- 副信息区：可放拼音、英文名、简短 slogan、行业描述
- 细节区：可少量加入辅助小字、装饰线、标记信息，增强作品展示感

【排版要求】
1. 版式整体保持简洁、留白舒服、视觉集中。
2. 可以采用居中式、上下结构式或轻提案展示式排版。
3. 主 logo 最大，品牌名次之，其他说明信息较小。
4. 不要堆太多信息，不要做得像宣传海报。
5. 画面应像设计作品集中的一页高完成度 logo 展示图。

PHASE 1: BACKGROUND SURFACE

A flat matte surface filling the entire frame. Surface material: thick matte art paper or fine-grain painted board — not glossy, not reflective, not plastic. Fine visible grain — like thick watercolor paper or a matte painted surface. This grain texture is visible at macro distance as a subtle micro-texture. ---

PHASE 2: GRATED PARMIGIANO-REGGIANO — MAXIMUM REALISM CRITICAL

The logo positive form is made entirely of freshly grated Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese. This is the hero material — every detail of the cheese texture must be physically accurate and photographically real.

Physical properties of freshly grated Parmigiano-Reggiano: a mix of particle types present simultaneously — short fine powder-like dust from the hardest zones, small irregular granules 1 to 3mm, medium irregular flakes 3 to 8mm, and occasional longer curling shreds 8 to 15mm that twist slightly as they fall from the grater. Color: off-white to pale cream — #F5F0E0 to #EDE8D0, with some slightly more yellow particles #E8DEBB where the cheese is denser. Individual particles catch the overhead light differently — particles with their flat face upward appear bright near-white, particles on their side appear slightly shadowed and more cream-colored.

Pile construction: the cheese is piled to a physical height of 4 to 8mm within the logo form — enough to create clearly visible soft micro-shadows beneath the pile where it meets the red background. The pile is not uniform — slightly higher and denser along the center axis of each stroke or form element, naturally thinning toward the edges. The pile has genuine three-dimensional volume — a real mound of grated cheese with a slightly rounded top surface. At the very edges of the logo form individual cheese shreds and particles extend beyond the main mass — some long curling shreds breach the logo boundary by 3 to 10mm, small particles scatter 5 to 20mm beyond the edge. This organic fringe is critical for realism.

Surface of the cheese pile: the top surface is an irregular landscape of individual particles at various angles — some standing slightly upright, some lying flat, some partially overlapping others. Individual long shreds visible curling across the surface. The texture is rich, dense, and complex — at 400% zoom every individual particle should be identifiable and distinct.

---

PHASE 3: SCATTERED PARTICLES ONLY — NO PROPS

The image contains only two elements: the grated cheese logo form and the red background surface. No cheese wedge. No broken chunks. No grater. No peppercorns. No additional food props of any kind. Clean, minimal, editorial.

Scattered particles: across the red background surface outside the logo form — sparse individual cheese particles that have naturally fallen during the formation of the logo. Small granules, occasional short shreds, fine dust. More concentrated in a loose radius of 20 to 40mm around the logo boundary, becoming sparser toward the frame edges. Approximately 60 to 100 individual scattered particles across the background. These confirm the physical process of grating and placing the cheese.

---

PHASE 4: LIGHTING — OVERHEAD FOOD PHOTOGRAPHY

Camera position: directly overhead, perfectly perpendicular to the surface — zero angle, zero perspective, pure top-down flat-lay.

Lighting: a single large diffused overhead light source — 120×120cm softbox positioned directly above the scene at 60 to 80cm. Very slight forward offset of 10 to 15° from perfectly overhead — creates short soft micro-shadows beneath the cheese pile confirming its physical presence on the surface. Shadow direction: very slightly away from camera, barely perceptible. Shadow softness: very soft edge, almost fully diffused.

Effect on cheese pile: overhead light catches every individual particle. Upward-facing flat surfaces of particles: near-white bright highlights. Side-facing surfaces: slightly shadowed cream-warm tone. Base of pile where it meets the red surface: soft shadow gradient 2 to 4mm wide — red surface darkens slightly where the cheese pile blocks the overhead light. This base shadow confirms pile height and is critical for realism.

Effect on background: completely uniformly lit — no hot spots, no falloff. Only micro-shadows from cheese particles create any variation.

---

PHASE 5: COMPOSITION & CAMERA

Aspect ratio: 4:5 portrait — editorial magazine format. Logo form centered in frame — positioned at vertical center or very slightly above center. Logo occupies 45 to 60% of total frame height — large, commanding, clearly legible. Generous red background visible on all sides. Camera: directly overhead, zero tilt, zero rotation — the logo silhouette reads as the correct [BRAND NAME] mark from this top-down view. Lens: 85mm equivalent at close focus distance — no distortion. Entire scene in sharp focus. Aperture: f/8 to f/11 — everything sharp simultaneously.

---

PHASE 6: TECH SPECS — MAXIMUM PHOTOREALISM

Render: Houdini particle simulation + Redshift or Mantra, OR photorealistic CGI achieving identical result. This image must be indistinguishable from a real food photography shot.

Cheese geometry: every individual particle of grated cheese is a real geometric object — not a texture map, not a normal map, not instanced flat planes. Each particle has its own 3D geometry: irregular rounded granules, flat irregular flakes with slight curvature, long curling shreds with natural twist. Minimum 50,000 individual cheese particle instances within the logo form. Each particle casts its own micro-shadow on the red surface and on adjacent particles.

Cheese material: physically accurate dairy material shader. Base color: #F2EDD8 to #EDE4C4 with 15% random per-particle color variation. Subsurface scattering: active — light scatters through particles making thin edges slightly translucent. SSS radius: 3 to 5mm, SSS color warm cream #FFE8C0. Roughness: 0.55 to 0.70. Specular: 0.05 to 0.1 — small soft highlights on particles facing the light. No metalness.

Background material: matte paper shader — roughness 0.92, fine displacement grain 0.1mm amplitude, albedo #CC1414, no specularity.

Lighting: one large rectangular area light 120×120cm, overhead with 12° forward tilt, 5500K neutral white. No secondary lights. No HDRI. No colored lights.

Ray tracing: minimum 12 bounces. Subsurface scattering: mandatory on all cheese materials. Micro-shadows: physically accurate from every particle instance. Anti-aliasing: maximum. Sampling: minimum 4096 samples per pixel. No film grain. No post-process color grading. Output feel: the cheese must look so real the viewer can smell it. This image is submitted to Bon Appétit as a real photograph and passes.

---

【核心要求】根据【类目】自动匹配最合理、最自然的包装组合与产品形态，并围绕【品牌名字】建立统一的品牌视觉系统。画面中应选择少量但有代表性的包装形式，组成一组完整而精炼的品牌包装系统，不追求堆砌数量，而强调主次层级、品牌统一性与陈列美感。可根据类目合理选择以下包装类型中的一部分：手提袋 / 购物袋、纸盒 / 礼盒 / 外包装盒、长条盒 / 单品盒 / 套装盒、包装袋 / 封套 / 小样袋 / 软袋、杯子 / 瓶子 / 罐子 / 管状容器 / 喷雾瓶 / 泵头瓶、标签 / 贴纸 / 封签 / 吊牌 / 小卡片，以及与类目对应的真实产品本体。

【类目适配逻辑】包装形式与产品形态需要根据【类目】自动匹配，但不局限于单一方向。可参考以下适配逻辑自由发散：若类目为食品 / 烘焙 / 零食 / 饮品，则以纸袋、纸盒、包装袋、杯子、食品容器、贴纸、封签及真实产品本体为主；若类目为茶饮 / 咖啡 / 饮料，则以杯子、瓶子、罐装包装、提袋、杯套、封口贴、礼盒等为主；若类目为美妆 / 护肤 / 彩妆 / 香水，则以瓶、罐、管、盒、礼盒、手提袋、小样包装等为主；若类目为香氛 / 家居 / 生活方式，则以香薰瓶、蜡烛杯、包装盒、礼盒、提袋、吊卡、标签卡等为主；若类目为服饰 / 饰品 / 潮玩 / 文创，则以包装盒、抽屉盒、防尘袋、手提袋、贴纸、吊牌、配件包装等为主；若类目为数码配件 / 工具 / 小型消费品，则以硬盒、外包装盒、收纳袋、说明卡、贴纸、封套、标签等为主。整体必须体现“类目合理、品牌统一、包装成体系”的效果。

【数量与密度控制】请控制画面中的物件数量，不要过多堆砌，也不要把所有可能包装形式全部展示出来。整体应呈现“少而精、完整但不拥挤”的品牌包装系统效果。建议选择最具代表性的包装载体进行展示：大件包装 1～2 个，中型包装 2～3 个，小型包装或辅助物件 2～4 个，真实产品本体 1～3 个，总可见元素建议控制在 6～10 个之间。包装种类应体现层次变化与系统感，但不宜重复过多同类物件。画面需要有足够留白与呼吸感，确保每个包装都清晰可见、主次明确、摆放舒展，宁可少而精，也不要为了“完整”而过度塞满。

【品牌视觉系统要求】所有包装必须属于同一个品牌系统，统一使用【品牌名字】作为核心品牌识别元素。整体应具备一致的 logo / 标志呈现、字体风格、图形语言、插画语言或纹样系统、排版逻辑、配色体系、材质与印刷质感。品牌调性、色彩方向、图案元素、辅助图形和视觉氛围，请根据【类目】自动匹配并合理发散，不局限于任何固定风格。整体风格应统一、协调、具有品牌识别度，可以是简约高级、自然有机、时尚现代、轻奢精致、年轻清新、艺术感、潮流个性或经典优雅，但必须符合【类目】特征，并呈现成熟品牌的设计完成度。

【配色机制要求】整体配色不要固化为某一种固定组合，也不要连续多次出现高度相似的主色系统。每次生成时应根据【类目】与品牌气质，主动形成不同的主色方案与配色关系，采用“受控发散”的方式进行色彩演绎。色彩可以是低饱和自然色、现代中性色、轻复古色、明快清新色、轻奢深色系或艺术感综合色系，但必须保持高级、统一、克制、有品牌感。允许每次生成时呈现不同的视觉气质，例如奶油白与焦糖棕、雾灰蓝与暖白、橄榄绿与亚麻米、酒红与奶霜白、可可棕与象牙白、炭灰与麦秆金、雾粉灰与米白、海军蓝与暖灰等，仅作为参考方向而非固定模板。不要荧光色，不要廉价高饱和，不要杂乱失控的多色拼贴。

【画面构图与陈列要求】画面采用品牌包装家族陈列逻辑，而不是杂乱堆放。整体为商业摄影棚场景，使用 3/4 轻俯视角或略带透视的正面陈列角度，形成有层次、有秩序、有主次的包装展示画面。构图参考以下逻辑：后景摆放 1～2 个较大的包装作为视觉支撑，如手提袋、大礼盒、大外盒；中景安排品牌核心包装或主力单品包装，作为主要视觉焦点；前景摆放较小包装、辅助包装、标签、贴纸及真实产品本体；至少有一个真实产品与包装产生自然互动，如产品半露出、摆放在包装前方、与包装组合展示；整体形成平衡而有设计感的三角式或错落式构图。画面干净、有留白、不拥挤，内容丰富但克制，以有限而精准的包装组合体现完整的品牌包装生态。

【视觉风格要求】整体呈现高端商业摄影质感与品牌提案感，背景为干净的摄影棚环境，可为白色、暖白色、浅灰色，或根据品牌调性自动匹配的极简背景。画面应强调真实的包装材质表现、清晰的纸张折痕、盒型结构、瓶罐轮廓、标签细节、印刷质感、压纹 / 烫金 / 哑光 / 棉纸纹理 / 牛皮纸纹理等材质细节，以及统一而高级的配色搭配、精致现代干净的品牌视觉语言和强烈的“这是一整套品牌包装系统”的完整感。

【光影要求】采用真实商业摄影级光影，可为柔和棚拍光，也可带有轻微方向性的自然侧光。需要有清晰但克制的阴影，以增强立体感、空间感与高级感。整体光线通透、明亮、干净，不要阴暗，不要廉价感，不要杂乱背景。

【最终效果要求】最终画面应像一个成熟品牌的包装系统展示海报、包装家族提案图或品牌视觉落地效果图，而不是零散商品拼图。重点突出：固定 4:5 竖版海报感、品牌统一性、包装家族完整性、商业摄影感、设计提案感、类目适配性，以及高级审美与视觉完成度。

Act as a High-End Commercial Product Photographer and Creative Director shooting a luxury editorial campaign (Hypebeast / Highsnobiety /Wallpaper* level).

PHASE 1: BRAND INTELLIGENCE
The hero subject is a [OBJECT] branded for [BRAND NAME]. Autonomously determine [BRAND NAME]'s full visual identity: signature color palette, typographic DNA, logo mark geometry, material language, and cultural positioning. Apply this identity to the [OBJECT] with precision — do not invent a generic brand, decode the real visual codes.

PHASE 2: OBJECT SURFACE & MATERIAL DNA
Regardless of the shape of [OBJECT], apply this material system: Base tone: deep neutral — matte dark graphite, warm charcoal, or matte black. Fine-grain surface micro-texture visible under raking light — powder-coat, matte paper, or brushed material feel. Subtle gradient bloom: the base color dissolves in the lower portion of the object's surface into the brand's most iconic accent color — a soft luminous haze from within the material, not a printed graphic. Logo application: embossed, debossed, or metallic foil relief — catching specular light at edges only. Precise. Restrained. Typography: brand-accurate typeface, small tracking, positioned  with editorial intentionality.

PHASE 3: THE ACCENT BREAKOUT ELEMENT
This is the signature design move — adapt it to the natural geometry of [OBJECT]: Identify the most logical "interruption zone" on [OBJECT] — a seam, edge, band, collar, rim, strap, or wrap point. At this zone, apply a narrow saturated accent element in the brand's most iconic hue — vivid, slightly matte. This element must visually "break out" of the object's boundary — extending, protruding, or wrapping beyond the expected edge, creating a deliberate 3D tension between the object and the detail.The accent element carries a micro-typographic brand detail — tagline, model name, or descriptor — small, precise, tracked.

PHASE 4: STAGING & COMPOSITION
Studio cyclorama. Surface tone: off-white to warm light gray. Background field: cool neutral mid-gray, darker in upper zone. [OBJECT] positioned at 3/4 angle — front face and one secondary surface simultaneously visible. Rule of thirds: object occupies right 60% of frame. Left field: generous negative space — intentional, not empty. Single hard-edged directional shadow cast to the right and slightly downward — crisp penumbra, no diffusion.

PHASE 5: LIGHTING
Single dominant key light: large softbox, camera-left, elevated at 40°. Specular highlight traces the top-left edge of [OBJECT] — revealing material grain. Shadow side: no fill. Darkness earns depth. Subtle ambient bounce from cyclorama floor — lifts shadow by 15%, no more. Accent element receives micro-specular glint along its dominant edge. Mood: Rembrandt chiaroscuro logic applied to product photography. No lens flare. No atmospheric effects.

PHASE 6: TECH SPECS
Lens: 85mm equivalent, f/4.5. Depth of field: object fully sharp, background softened. Chromatic aberration: subtle, at extreme frame edges only — optical realism signal. Film grain overlay: 15% opacity — anti-CGI-plastic treatment. Render: Octane / Ray Tracing quality —subsurface scattering where material demands it, global illumination, physically accurate shadow falloff. Aspect ratio: autonomously determine optimal ratio for this [OBJECT] format.

[BRAND NAME] + [HERO COLOR]

Act as a Mixed-Media Campaign Art Director. Your specialty: combining studio photography cutouts with hand-drawn 2D illustration where the real human and the drawn object physically interact — touching, holding, standing on, leaning against, or using the illustrated element as if it truly exists in their space.

PHASE 1: CANVAS & COLOR SYSTEM

Format: 1:1 square canvas. Base: single flat saturated color [HERO COLOR]. No gradients. No texture. Pure chromatic field.
Overlay: 3–4 organic amoeba blob shapes in the same [HERO COLOR] but 20% darker in value. Smooth edges, irregular silhouettes, scattered asymmetrically. Some bleeding off-frame.
Hand-painted feel, clean execution.

PHASE 2: AUTONOMOUS OBJECT SELECTION

BEFORE staging the scene, the AI must first  make two autonomous decisions:
DECISION 1 — SELECT THE OBJECT: Analyze [BRAND NAME] and identify ONE iconic physical object from this framework:
— What is the single most recognizable product or artifact this brand has ever made?
— What object do fans of this brand collect, use daily, or photograph?
— What prop has defined this brand's visual identity across decades?
Do NOT choose animals. Do NOT choose logos. Choose a real, large, tangible object that can physically occupy space next to a person.
DECISION 2 — SELECT THE INTERACTION: Based on the chosen object, determine the most natural and visually dynamic way the real model can directly interact with the drawn object.
Interaction must be:
✓ Physical and direct — hands touching, feet on, body leaning, arms around
✓ Immediately readable — the relationship between person and object is understood in under 2 seconds
✓ Scaled correctly — the object must be large enough to interact with at human scale
✓ Active, not passive — the model is DOING something with the object, not just standing next to it
INTERACTION TYPE EXAMPLES (AI selects the most brand-appropriate):
· HOLDING: model's real hands grip the illustrated object — cup, camera, trophy, bottle, bag
· WEARING/USING: model's real body wears or uses the object — sitting on a chair, wearing an illustrated hat, holding an illustrated product to their face
· STANDING ON: model's real feet are planted on top of the illustrated object — skateboard, surfboard, podium, giant sneaker
· RIDING/LEANING: model's real body leans against or drapes over the illustrated object — car hood, shopping cart, giant product silhouette
· EMERGING FROM: model appears to step out of or through the illustrated object — bursting through a giant sneaker box, rising from an illustrated cup

PHASE 3: STAGING THE SCENE

Once object and interaction are selected, stage the full scene:
MODEL:
Single model age 18–26, clean cutout, zero fringing. Pose is determined by the chosen interaction — the body position must make the interaction feel natural and physically believable.
Wardrobe: [BRAND NAME]'s most iconic apparel in [HERO COLOR] monochromatic palette.
ILLUSTRATED OBJECT: Pure white (#FFFFFF) flat 2D illustration. Brush-pen marker line quality, 3–5px weight. Slightly imperfect organic edges — hand-drawn feel, not vector-perfect. NO shading. NO gradients. Flat white fill only.

SCALE RULE — CRITICAL: The illustrated object must be LARGE. Minimum size: 40% of canvas height. The object should feel monumental — oversized relative to real-world scale  is acceptable and encouraged.  A coffee cup can be waist-height.  A sneaker can be as tall as the model. Large scale = better readability =  stronger visual impact.
DEPTH LAYERING — CRITICAL:The object must exist on multiple z-layers:
— Parts of the object sit BEHIND the model
— Parts of the object come IN FRONT of the model
— The model's real hands/feet make contact  at the intersection point
This layering is what makes the scene feel integrated rather than collaged.
BRAND STAMP:
One small [BRAND NAME] logo mark appears on the object's surface — naturally embedded as if printed, engraved, or stitched. Rendered in [HERO COLOR] darker variant. Subtle, not dominant.

PHASE 4: SUPPORTING ILLUSTRATION SYSTEM

All supporting elements: white, flat, brush-pen line style. Same visual language as the hero object.
LOGO MARKS:
[BRAND NAME] primary icon in white:
— Large (upper-left corner, ~15% canvas width)
— Medium (opposite corner, ~10% canvas width)
IMPACT MARKERS: 2–3 manga-style exclamation dash clusters  near the point of interaction between  model and object — where hands grip,  where feet land, where bodies touch. This emphasizes the physical connection.
MOTION LINES: 2–4 curved speed lines radiating from  the object or the model's most active body part. Taper at ends. Cross behind and in front of the model for depth.

GROUND EFFECT: At the base of the scene: white illustrated  ground interaction — sparkle stars,  short speed dashes, or object-specific  effect (splash if cup, dust clouds  if sneaker landing, wheel tracks if skateboard).
AMBIENT SQUIGGLES: 1–2 loose organic white lines floating near the model's torso — visual rhythm connecting the photographic and illustrated layers.

PHASE 5: LIGHTING

Studio strobe, high-key, even and clean. 5500K neutral. No dramatic shadows on model. Soft contact shadow at model's feet (opacity 15%). The photography reads as natural and real  against the graphic illustrated environment.

TECH SPECS

Aesthetic: mixed media — real photograph integrated with hand-drawn 2D illustration. Color count: 3 maximum — [HERO COLOR] light, [HERO COLOR] dark blobs, white illustration. Photography skin tones and fabric colors  are the only additional color exception. Illustration style: Y2K comic energy,  Japanese streetwear magazine, brush marker. Composition: asymmetric and dynamic.  The interaction point between model and  object is the visual center of gravity — everything else orbits around it. No text. No wordmarks. Logo icon only. Mood: the model is not posing WITH the object —  the model is IN THE MIDDLE of using it.  Caught mid-action. Alive.

- Analyze [BRAND NAME] category:

人物・表情：

服装・ポーズ：
白い長袖シャツ、黒に近いネイビーの短めプリーツスカート、黒いローファー。シャツは強い雨で完全に濡れて重くなり、肩、袖、胸元、腰まわりに水を含んだ皺と貼りつきが出ているが、透けすぎず、露出や下着の強調はしない。スカートも雨で濡れて裾が重くまとまり、太ももに雨粒が流れている。肩には濡れたベージュのトートバッグ。人物はホーム右側の柱の近くに立ち、身体は線路側へやや斜め、重心は両足にまっすぐ乗せる。人物自身の右手は身体の横に力なく下ろし、左手はバッグのストラップを軽く握る。背中は少し反らし、顔だけを雨の方へ上げる。

背景・光：
山間にある古い無人駅のホーム、夕方から夜にかかる青い雨の時間。画面左には雨に濡れた単線の線路が奥へカーブし、遠くに赤い信号灯が滲んでいる。背景には濃い緑の山、濡れた草、古い木造の駅舎、白いホームライン、水たまりがある。強い雨が画面全体に縦方向の線として落ち、屋根の端から水が連続して流れ落ちる。主光源はホーム右上の蛍光灯で、人物の顔、濡れた髪、肩、シャツの上面を冷たい白色で照らす。画面左奥の赤い信号灯が床の水たまりに長く反射し、足元に赤い揺らぎを作る。影は人物の背後と柱の奥へ柔らかく落ち、背景は雨霧で少し暗く沈む。

構図・カメラ：
縦長 4:5。全身が入る中距離の写真構図。人物は画面右三分の一に配置し、足元まで見せる。画面左側には線路とホームの長い奥行きを大きく残し、雨と赤い反射で視線を奥へ導く。カメラは胸の高さより少し低い位置、ほぼ平視。人物の横顔と濡れた服の質感に焦点を合わせ、背景の山と線路はやや柔らかくぼかす。広角すぎず、自然な圧縮感。屋根、柱、線路、白線で縦横のフレームを作り、静かな緊張感を出す。

高品質な日系写真表現。アニメではなくリアル写真寄り。雨粒、濡れた布、濡れた髪、肌の水滴、床の反射を丁寧に描写。色調は青灰色、深い緑、赤い信号光、蛍光灯の白を中心にした梅雨の夕暮れ。過度なHDRや強い加工を避け、湿度のある柔らかなコントラスト、自然な粒子感、少しフィルム写真のような落ち着いた質感。

主題：
月灯りの部屋

人物・表情：
20代女性。自然な小顔で、やわらかな輪郭。ダークブラウンのショートボブで、毛先に軽い外ハネとゆるい動きがある。前髪は薄く目にかかる程度。メイクは清透感のある日系メイクで、肌はなめらかだが過度に加工しない。表情は落ち着いていて少し眠たげ、唇は軽く開き、視線はカメラへやさしく向ける。耳元には繊細なハートモチーフの揺れるピアス。

服装・ポーズ：
ライトグレーの柔らかいリブ素材のキャミソールと、同色のルームショートパンツ。室内でくつろぐ自然な部屋着。女性は床に座るように寄りかかり、上半身をやや後ろへ倒す。人物自身の左腕は頭の横で軽く曲げ、左手の指先を髪に添える。右腕は体の横に自然に下ろす。両膝は手前に立て、脚が前景に入る構図。無理のない重心で、リラックスした夜の姿勢。

背景・光：
夜の室内。木の床、背後に大きな窓、窓の外には青い夜空と丸い月、遠くの街明かり。画面左奥に大きめの観葉植物、右奥に棚と小さなランプ、淡いカーテン。主光源は画面右奥の暖色ランプで、顔の右側、肩、首元、胸元にやわらかいオレンジ寄りの光を当てる。副光として窓から青い月明かりが入り、髪の輪郭と左側の空気感を少し冷たく縁取る。影は深すぎず、夜らしい落ち着いたコントラスト。

構図・カメラ：
縦長構図。ローアングル寄りのミディアムショットで、脚が手前、顔と上半身が中央に来る。人物は画面中央。カメラはやや近めで、顔から腹部までをしっかり見せる。焦点は瞳と顔。背景はほどよくぼかし、室内の月夜の雰囲気を残す。

質感・スタイル：
リアル寄りの写真風ビジュアル。自然な肌理、やわらかな陰影、布のリブ感、木床の落ち着いた反射を丁寧に描写。色は暖色のランプ光と寒色の月光の対比を大切にし、全体は静かな夜のムード。過度な彩度や不自然な艶は避け、上品でナイトポートレートに仕上げる。

ネガティブ：
不自然な顔、視線のずれ、余分または欠けた指、手足の融合、関節の破綻、浮いた髪、衣服の破綻、左右非対称のピアス、過度な露出、下品な表現、プラスチックのような肌、過度な美肌補正、光源と矛盾する影、背景物の歪み、不要な文字、ロゴ、透かし。

debossing aesthetic (印压凹凸立体画风), panoramic bird's-eye view of [City]'s  

single most iconic historical or cultural landmark.

[OVERALL TECHNIQUE]

The entire image is rendered as if pressed or embossed into thick ivory-white 

paper or plaster — all forms are created through subtle relief, shadow, and 

highlight rather than flat color or line art. Minimalist line-carving technique 

(极简线描手法) defines architectural edges. The background is a clean, seamless 

ivory-white (乳白色), with no visible horizon line or sky detail — just soft 

gradient emptiness receding into the distance.

[LANDMARK SUBJECT — AUTO-DERIVED FROM CITY]

Identify the single most globally recognizable architectural or monumental 

landmark associated with [City] — the one structure that, if shown in silhouette 

alone, would be instantly identified as representing [City]. Render a symmetrical, 

wide-angle bird's-eye view of this landmark and its immediate architectural 

surroundings (courtyards, plazas, gardens, colonnades, gates, or approach paths 

— whatever is authentic to that specific landmark's real layout). The full 

complex recedes into the distance along a strong central axis, with repeating 

symmetrical structures flanking both sides in diminishing scale, creating strong 

linear perspective and depth. All structures share the same ivory-white embossed 

material as the background, distinguished only by relief depth, shadow, and fine 

linework.

[GOLD ACCENT — HERO BUILDING]

The single most iconic structure within that landmark complex is positioned at 

the mid-ground, centered, rendered with matte gold texture (哑金光质感) picking 

out its structural details — roofline, facade ornamentation, columns, doorways, 

or spire, whatever is architecturally authentic to it. This building's edges 

emit a low-intensity warm white glow (低亮度白光), as if lit from within or by 

soft dawn light, making it the clear focal point against the otherwise 

monochrome ivory scene.

[TYPOGRAPHY]

Centered in the composition, positioned in front of or just above the hero 

building: a serif wordmark reading the country or region name in English, 

followed by a vertical bar, followed by the landmark's name in its native 

language and script — e.g. formatted as "[Country] | [Landmark Native Name]" 

— in elegant refined gold serif type. The text width spans roughly half the 

frame's width — commanding but not oversized.

At the bottom of the composition:

- Lower left corner, very small text: today's date in "YYYY Mon.DD" format

Both in the same muted gold tone, minimal, unobtrusive.

[COMPOSITION]

Wide symmetrical composition, camera positioned at a high elevated angle looking 

down the central axis of the complex. Negative white space occupies 

approximately 60% of the frame — generous emptiness above and around the 

architecture emphasizes depth, scale, and stillness. The vanishing point sits 

at the upper-center of the frame, where the architecture recedes into soft 

white haze.

[STYLE REFERENCES]

Combine: Akira Yamaguchi's meticulous architectural detail work, Tadao Ando's 

minimalist symmetry and negative space philosophy, Zao Wou-Ki's abstract sense 

of spatial depth, George Segal's soft sculptural relief quality, and Wim 

Wenders' elevated urban framing sensibility. The embossed texture should feel 

naturally hand-pressed — uniform, clean linework with no visual noise or 

artifacts.

[QUALITY & MOOD]

8K quality rendering, rich fine detail throughout, evoking a serene, radiant 

atmosphere (宁静辉光). The image should feel like a reinterpretation of 

[City]'s most iconic landmark — where historical weight and contemporary art 

intersect — delivering a visually tranquil yet culturally resonant narrative.

你是顶尖的艺术总监兼日文排版设计师。请将以下内容作为“制作步骤”，从 STEP 1 开始依次累积，完成一张纵横比 4:5 的实拍编辑广告海报。每一步都要基于前一步的结果叠加进行。

【附件】第1张＝SNS个人资料截图，第2张＝本人照片或头像图片

━ STEP 1｜决定标题的一个单词 ━
・阅读截图中的头衔・自我介绍・领域，从中选出一个象征这个人的英文单词（例：设计相关→DESIGN）。不要使用名字。这个单词将成为主角。

━ STEP 2｜在纯白背景上，将该单词逆时针旋转90度，横向放置在左侧 ━
・背景为纯白
・将选定的单词整体逆时针旋转90度，使其横向倒置（文字呈水平倾斜状态）
・将这个巨大的横向倒置文字，以画面左侧为起点，以超特大尺寸占据画面高度进行配置

━ STEP 3｜制作“文字＋方块”的剪切蒙版 ━
・这一步暂不使用照片。只制作蒙版（用于剪切的模板）
・添加一个与 STEP 2 中制作的巨大横向倒置文字相同纵向宽度的方形块。
将这个方形块与巨大横向倒置文字的末端重叠，并将方块的横向宽度延伸至画面边缘。
但不要改变 STEP 2 中制作的文字尺寸，只将方形块的横向宽度最大限度延伸。
・将这两个图形“融合”后，创建剪切蒙版。

━ STEP 4｜将人物图像置于整个画面，并用 STEP 3 的蒙版剪切 ━
・将附件中的人物图像放大・裁剪，使脸部占据画面大部分，并配置于整个画面
・用 STEP 3 中制作的蒙版形状剪切该照片（进行剪切）。照片仅在蒙版内部可见，内部以一张无中断的照片填充

━ STEP 5｜在剩余空间配置小文本 ━
・在 STEP 4 完成的图像上，将从截图中读取的信息翻译成英文并配置
・在 STEP 4 图像的左右两侧，为配置从截图中读取的信息创建白色实心区域。
・小文本也逆时针旋转90度（横向倒置），沿余白垂直线性流动（不要水平放置）
・左侧：TITLE＝本人姓名／角色／经验／社交媒体，简短引用导语／右侧：@用户名／企划名称／西元年
・避免过度堆积，注意平衡进行配置

━ STEP 6｜添加收尾元素 ━
・在底部水平添加细条形条码风格图形。用小型点或线等最小限度装饰调整余白

【所有 STEP 共通的质感】
・附件中的人物照片或头像作为“人物形象的灵感来源”处理。不要直接复制・再现脸部，而是继承从中读取到的氛围・发型・发色・眼镜或小物件・服装风格・表情柔和度等特征
・如果附件是插图或角色头像，也读取颜色运用・发型・眼镜・氛围等特征，并转换为反映这些特征的实拍模特
・避免过度 AI 感，营造如同真实广告拍摄般的自然表情・肌肤・头发・姿势・服装质感
・采用明亮高调且富有通透感的光线（禁止昏暗室内・沉闷灰色）
・配色基于截图来源重新设计为广告风格，设置一个吸引视线的重点色
・避免普通商务服，采用与世界观相符的独特造型
・纵横比 4:5，高分辨率，时尚广告品质

主題：
夜の洗濯待ち

人物・表情：
20歳女性。すらりとしたモデル体型で、健康的で女性らしいシルエット。顔立ちは精致で可愛い印象、丸みのある小顔、自然な二重、澄んだ瞳、小さめの鼻、やわらかな口元。髪は暗めブラウンの肩上ミディアム、ゆるい外ハネと軽いウェーブ、透け感のある前髪。メイクは清透感のある日系メイク、薄いローズチーク、ピンクベージュのリップ、控えめな涙袋、細く長いまつ毛。表情は静かで少しだけ微笑む程度、カメラをまっすぐ見る。

服装・ポーズ：
上半身はカーキベージュの細リブキャミソールのみ。下半身は黒のハイウエスト包臀ミニスカート、黒の薄手ストッキング、黒のショートブーツ。小さなピアスと細いネックレス。右肩と背中を画面右側の洗濯機に軽く預け、腰を少し斜めに流す。人物自身の右手は洗濯カードをつまみ、スカート横に自然に下ろす。人物自身の左手は太ももの横で力を抜く。両脚は軽く交差させ、重心は画面右側の脚に置く。服のしわ、肩紐、手指、足元の接地を自然に描写する。

背景・光：
コインランドリーの夜。画面右側に縦に並ぶドラム式洗濯機、奥に洗剤販売機と古い案内表示、床にランドリーバスケット。前景の左右に黒いドア枠や壁を大きくぼかして入れ、隙間から覗き見るような空間にする。天井の蛍光灯が左上から斜めに当たり、顔、鎖骨、肩、キャミソールの凹凸をやわらかく照らす。影は右下と奥へ落ちる。洗濯機の金属面に弱い反射光、奥の販売機から青白い小さな光。背景の日本語文字は環境文字として自然に、細部は読めすぎない程度。

構図・カメラ：
縦長3:4。全身ポートレート。人物は画面中央よりやや右、全身が画面の約70％を占める。前景の黒い縦フレームで左右を大胆に隠し、中央に細い視線の通り道を作る。カメラは胸の高さより少し低め、軽い平視。中望遠寄りの圧縮感、背景は浅くぼける。焦点は瞳、脚元と奥の洗濯機は少し柔らかくする。

質感・スタイル：
リアルな写真風。夜の低照度スナップ、35mmフィルムのような粒子、少し暖色の蛍光灯、暗部は深め、肌は過度に磨かず自然な質感を残す。色調はベージュ、黒、くすんだグリーン、青白い機械光で統一。雑誌写真ではなく、偶然撮れたような静かなドキュメンタリー感。

ネガティブ：
不自然な顔や視線、過度に大きい目、尖りすぎた顎、余分または欠けた指、手足の融合、脚のねじれ、関節の破綻、カードとの接触不良、浮いた足、不自然な重力、洗濯機の円形扉の歪み、誤った遠近法、光源と矛盾する影、過度な美肌補正、プラスチックのような肌、露出過多、不要な人物、読めるブランドロゴ、文字化け、透かし、過度なAI感。

[BRAND NAME] + [PRODUCT]

Act as a senior luxury fashion art director and studio product photographer creating a premium key visual for a flagship campaign, an e-commerce editorial, and mobile-first brand content.

PHASE 1: FORMAT AND CANVAS

Create a vertical 9:16 composition. Use a single, completely flat warm off-white background, never pure white and never gray. Aim for a soft ivory cream similar to #F4EFE6, with no visible shadowing across the background plane.

Automatically infer the signature neutral background tone associated with [BRAND NAME]. If the brand is known for a house color used in packaging, tissue paper, lookbooks, or campaign materials, subtly shift the canvas toward that recognized off-white or neutral. The final image should feel like an official brand asset, not a generic studio render.

PHASE 2: BACKGROUND PATTERN WATERMARK

Identify [BRAND NAME]'s iconic surface language, such as its monogram, toile, geometric logo repeat, heritage emblem, archival motif, or signature textile pattern.

Apply that pattern across the full background as a ghosted watermark. Keep it tone-on-tone, using the same base color family with a slight value difference of roughly 8 to 12 percent lighter or darker than the canvas. Make the pattern large in scale, with individual motifs taking up about 15 to 25 percent of the canvas width. Keep opacity between 10 and 18 percent. Avoid hard outlines. The pattern should feel embossed, woven, or softly pressed into the surface rather than printed. It must sit behind every foreground element.

PHASE 3: LOGO PLACEMENT

Recreate [BRAND NAME]'s official logo with high fidelity, including accurate letterforms, proportions, secondary marks, emblems, crowns, stars, monogram icons, or other brand-specific details.

Place the logo horizontally centered in the upper third of the frame, within the top 30 percent of the canvas. Scale it so it spans about 40 to 50 percent of the canvas width. It should be prominent, clean, and balanced.

Render the logo as flat 2D artwork with no extrusion, chrome, beveling, or dimensional effects. Use the official logo colorway for [BRAND NAME], matching the brand-standard color or colors seen on official packaging and websites. If the logo uses separate tones for an icon and wordmark, preserve that hierarchy precisely.

Directly beneath the main logo mark, add the full [BRAND NAME] wordmark in widely tracked capital letters. Use a clean geometric sans-serif style, tracking around +200 to +300, in the same brand color. The wordmark height should be about 60 percent of the main logo height. Do not place decorative dividers or extra symbols between the logo and wordmark.

PHASE 4: PRODUCT PLACEMENT

Render [PRODUCT] as a photorealistic studio object with maximum material accuracy.

Leather should show grain, pores, stitching texture, edge paint, and natural surface variation. Metal hardware should be gold or silver as appropriate, with believable micro-reflections and no flat coloring. Canvas, textile, and fabric should show woven fiber detail rather than smooth synthetic surfaces. Any brand-specific patterns on the product itself must be accurate, sharp, and legible.

Place the product so it enters from the bottom-right corner at a natural 25 to 35 degree angle, as if casually placed into frame or captured mid-motion. Crop the object intentionally so only about 60 to 75 percent of it is visible. The product should occupy the lower 55 to 65 percent of the image. The crop must feel editorial and intentional, not accidental.

Make the product feel physically present on the surface. Add an extremely soft contact shadow under the nearest edge, around 8 to 12 percent opacity. Do not use hard drop shadows.

PHASE 5: LIGHTING

Use the feeling of a large north-facing studio window. The light should be soft, directional, and almost shadowless on the background. Use neutral daylight between 5500K and 6000K, slightly cool but still natural.

Set the key light as a large softbox from the upper-left, evenly revealing the entire product surface. Keep contrast very low, roughly 1.2:1 to 1.5:1 maximum. Add a broad fill from the right to remove harsh shadows. Do not use rim light. Do not create dramatic contrast. The lighting should only reveal the product, never compete with it.

Enable subtle global illumination so product surfaces reflect onto one another naturally. Avoid specular hotspots on leather. Reserve crisp highlights mainly for metal hardware.

PHASE 6: TYPOGRAPHY AND FINISHING

At the bottom of the frame, place a thin horizontal rule, 1 px thick, centered, spanning about 80 percent of the canvas width, using the brand color. Beneath it, add one line of micro-copy in the same clean sans-serif family. It may be a social handle, collection name, campaign label, or small-caps editorial caption. Generate a contextually appropriate label for [BRAND NAME]. Keep it minimal, refined, and brand-correct.

TECH SPECS

Render as photorealistic CGI with the polish of Keyshot or Octane product visualization. Use ultra-high detail in a 9:16 vertical frame. Simulate f/16 depth of field so everything remains tack sharp. No bokeh. Product edges, stitches, patterns, hardware, and surface details must be crisp.

Use clean true-to-life tone mapping with no crushed shadows, no vignette, no grain, and no cinematic haze. Keep colors faithful to the real product, with only slight warmth in the ivory background. 砂漠の白馬

人物・表情：
20代女性。明るいアイボリーベージュ寄りの白肌で、ほんのりピンクの血色を含むなめらかな肌質。長いブラウンのウェーブヘアと薄いシースルーバング、風で髪先が少し流れている。大きすぎない自然な瞳、淡いローズピンクのチーク、ピンクベージュのツヤ感リップ。落ち着いたまなざしでカメラを見る、静かで少し物語性のある表情。

服装・ポーズ：
ブラウンのカウボーイハット、胸元を開けた白いウエスタンシャツをウエストで結び、内側に黒のブラトップ。スタッズ付きのデニムショートパンツ、太めのブラウンレザーベルト、ロング丈のブラウンカウボーイブーツ。白馬の鞍に自然に座り、上半身は少し斜めに起こす。人物の右手は手綱を軽く持ち、左手は太もも付近に自然に下ろす。脚は鞍と鐙に沿わせ、全体はアクションではなく、静かなファッションフォトのような乗馬ポーズ。

背景・光：
アメリカ西部風の乾いた砂漠。赤茶色の岩山が遠景にぼんやり見え、地面には乾いた砂、小石、低い灌木が点在する。白馬は四本足で地面に立ち、首を前下方へ下げている。空は鮮やかな青で、小さな白い雲が数個浮かぶ。昼の強い太陽光が画面左上から差し、人物の顔、肩、腹部、白馬の背中を明るく照らす。影は右下方向へ落ち、砂地からの反射光で馬の腹側と人物の肌に柔らかい明るさが入る。

構図・カメラ：
縦長 2:3。白馬と人物を中央に配置し、馬の全身がほぼ入る引きの構図。人物は画面上部寄り、白馬の頭は画面right下へ下がる。低めのカメラ位置から少し見上げる視点で、空の広さを大きく見せる。焦点は人物の顔、白馬の頭部、革の馬具に合わせ、遠景の岩山は軽くぼかす。広角寄りだが顔と体型が歪まない自然な遠近感。

質感・スタイル：
高精細な写真風ビジュアル。肌は自然な質感を残し、過度な美肌補正やプラスチック感を避ける。白馬の毛並み、革の鞍と手綱、デニムの擦れ、砂埃の粒子を丁寧に描写。彩度は高めで、青空、白馬、赤茶色の砂漠がはっきり映える。西部劇風の雰囲気とファッションポートレートを合わせた、明るく開放的な仕上がり。

ネガティブ：
不自然な顔や視線、過度に幼い顔、左右非対称の目、余分または欠けた指、手足の融合、関節の破綻、馬の脚の本数間違い、馬具との接触不良、浮遊、不自然な重力、誤った遠近法、光源と矛盾する影、過度な美肌補正、プラスチックのような肌、不要な人物、不要な銃、文字、ロゴ、透かし。

主題：
プールサイドの午後

人物・表情：
20代女性。明るいアイボリーベージュ寄りの白肌で、ほんのりピンクの血色を含んだなめらかな肌質。頬、鼻先、肩、鎖骨に柔らかなハイライト。精密で上品なドールライク日系メイク。淡いローズピンクのチーク、シャンパンベージュとピンクブラウンのアイシャドウ、細く長いまつ毛、自然な涙袋、明るめブラウンの柔らかい眉、透け感のあるピンクベージュのグロスリップ。瞳には小さく澄んだキャッチライト。カメラを見つめながら、控えめでやわらかい微笑み。

服装・ポーズ：
白いシンプルな三角タイプのスイムウェア。リゾートのプールサイドの木製デッキに腰掛ける。画面左側の脚をプールへ伸ばし、つま先で水面を軽く蹴って小さな水しぶきを作る。もう片方の膝は自然に立て、肘を膝に乗せて頬に手を添える。反対の手は身体の横でデッキに置き、指先まで自然に力を抜く。姿勢はリラックスしていて、上品で爽やかな夏のポートレート。

背景・光：
明るい屋外リゾートプール。前景に透明感のある青いプールの水面と細かな反射、人物の足元に小さな水しぶき。中景に木製デッキ、白いパラソル、白いソファ、鉢植えの南国風グリーン。背景に白いパーゴラと淡くぼけたリゾート建築。強い夏の日差しが左上から入り、頬、肩、鎖骨、脚、水面に明るいハイライト。影は右下方向へ落ちる。水面からの青い反射光が脚とデッキ下に淡く返る。

構図・カメラ：
縦構図、2:3。全身が入るプールサイドポートレート。人物は画面中央からやや右寄りに大きく配置し、脚のラインとプールの水面で奥行きを作る。カメラはやや低めの目線、自然な距離感。背景は浅めの被写界深度で柔らかくぼかし、人物の瞳と顔まわりにフォーカス。夏らしい明るい余白を空と背景側に残す。

質感・スタイル：
リアル写真表現。自然な肌理、細い産毛、控えめな水滴、髪の一本一本の流れを丁寧に描写。髪は明るいミルクティーアッシュブラウン。薄めのシースルーバング、顔まわりに沿うレイヤーカット、肩下までのミディアムロング。毛先は内側にゆるくカールし、ふんわりした空気感と自然な束感。白、ミルクティーブラウン、ターコイズブルー、植物のグリーンを基調にした清潔感のあるリゾート写真。

ネガティブ：
不自然な顔や視線、過度な美肌補正、プラスチックのような肌、余分または欠けた指、手足の融合、関節の破綻、足先の変形、スイムウェアの紐の破綻、デッキや水面との接触不良、不自然な水しぶき、光源と矛盾する影、過度な性的強調、下品なポーズ、不要な人物や小物、文字化け、ロゴ、透かし。

Ultra detailed Ufotable animation.
Fate Heaven's Feel cinematic quality.
Demon Slayer emotional weight and visual storytelling.
Movie-level visual effects.ESCENARIO SEGÚN LA BIBLIA Y ELENA G. DE WHITE:The Valley of Elah at high noon. A vast, sun-scorched valley flanked by two rocky hills. On one hill, the army of Israel, pale with fear, their armor dull, their spears trembling, their faces marked by forty days of terror. On the opposite hill, the Philistine camp, arrogant and boastful, their bronze shields flashing like a sea of fire. Between them, a dry riverbed littered with smooth, white stones, polished by centuries of water. The air is heavy with dust, tension, and the deafening echoes of a giant's taunts that have defied the armies of the living God for forty days and forty nights. No burning city. No destruction. Only the silence of an army that has forgotten God, and the voice of one man who dares to mock Him. The camera begins low to the ground, tracking over the white stones and dust. The sun beats down mercilessly. The sound of Goliath's roaring voice echoes through the valley, followed by the terrified whispers of Israelite soldiers. The sky is clear, almost cruelly indifferent, as if heaven itself is waiting for one person to believe.DAVID - THE SHEPHERD OF BETHLEHEM:Camera pans to a young man running from the Israelite camp. He is not a soldier. He wears no armor, carries no spear, no sword. He is a shepherd. His name is David. Age: Approximately 17. Ruddy complexion, reddish-brown hair, wind-tossed and dusty. Youthful face, still soft with adolescence, but his eyes burn with a fire that Israel has lost—unwavering faith in the living God. He wears a simple shepherd's tunic, dust-stained and simple. His only weapons: a staff in his hand, a leather pouch at his side, and a sling wrapped around his forehead. As Elena G. de White describes, "a divine radiance seemed to rest upon his face." He moves with the quiet confidence of one who has spent lonely nights in the fields of Bethlehem, speaking with God, killing lions and bears with his bare hands. He is not afraid of Goliath because he serves the God who delivered him from the paw of the lion and the paw of the bear. His face is calm, determined, and filled with righteous indignation at the giant's blasphemy. His clothing moves in the dry valley wind. His hair flows dramatically. His eyes never leave the giant.GOLIAT OF GATH - THE CHAMPION OF THE PHILISTINES:Across the valley, the ground trembles. Goliath steps forward. Height: Over nine feet (six cubits and a span). His bronze helmet gleams like a furnace in the midday sun. His scale armor of brass weighs over 125 pounds. His massive bronze greaves protect his legs. His spear shaft is as thick as a weaver's beam, the iron head weighing over 15 pounds. His shield-bearer walks before him, carrying a shield the size of a door. His face is scarred, brutal, covered in the arrogance of years of victory. His voice is like thunder, shaking the valley itself. He mocks the armies of Israel. He curses David by his gods. He defies the God of heaven. He is a mountain of flesh, bronze, and human pride. His shadow falls across the valley floor, stretching toward David—a visual of the impossible odds. He laughs. He roars. He raises his massive spear to crush the boy.THE ADVANCE - A SHEPHERD RUNS TOWARD A GIANT:Suddenly, David launches forward. Not with the speed of a trained warrior, but with the urgency of a shepherd running to save a lamb from a predator. His sandals kick up dust. The camera rapidly follows behind him, his tunic whipping through the air, his hair streaming, his sling already in his hand. He runs straight toward the giant, toward the danger, toward the impossible. The Israelite army watches in stunned silence. The Philistine army watches in mocking laughter. Goliath sees the boy, a child with a stick, and laughs—a deep, rumbling, godless sound that echoes off the valley walls. He curses David by his gods. He promises to feed his flesh to the birds of the air.Time slows. Extreme close-up. David's eyes. Not afraid. Not angry. Not vengeful. Absolutely certain. His lips move silently—a prayer that only heaven hears: "Thou comest to me with a sword, and with a spear, and with a shield: but I come to thee in the name of the Lord of hosts, the God of the armies of Israel, whom thou hast defied."THE SLING - THE STONE OF FAITH:David reaches into his leather pouch. His fingers find a smooth stone, polished by the water of the brook. He places it in his sling. The leather sings as he whirls it above his head, faster and faster, a blur of motion. The camera slows to hyper-slow motion. The stone rotating in the air, dust and sunlight catching its edges. The sling releases. The stone shoots forward like a beam of light—no magical glow, no energy trail, only the divine accuracy of God's hand guiding it.Goliath's eyes widen. For the first time in forty days, the giant feels something other than arrogance. Confusion. Then fear. He raises his massive shield, but too late. The stone finds its mark.Impact. The stone strikes Goliath's forehead with a sickening, thunderous crack. The camera captures the moment in sharp, brutal detail. The skin tearing. The bone sinking. The giant's eyes glazing over. Time seems to stop. Sparks of dust and sweat fly from the impact. The sound reverberates through the valley like a divine judgment. Goliath sways, his massive spear falling from his hand. His body crashes to the ground like a falling tower, a mountain of flesh and bronze collapsing into the dust. The valley shakes. The dust erupts like a cloud of witness.THE DECISIVE MOMENT - THE BATTLE IS THE LORD'S:David stands over the fallen giant. His chest heaves. His face is not triumphant, not cruel, not arrogant. It is reverent. He draws Goliath's own sword from its sheath—a massive blade too heavy for any ordinary man. He drags it through the dust toward the giant. The camera slowly pushes toward David. His face illuminated by the harsh sunlight, his eyes lifted to heaven, his lips moving in silent thanksgiving.He raises the sword. The camera captures the blade catching the light. "The battle is the Lord's," he whispers. He brings the sword down. One clean, decisive stroke. The camera does not show the gore. It shows the reaction. The camera pans to the Philistine army—their faces shifting from shock to terror, their lines breaking in panic, their bronze shields abandoned as they flee. The camera pans to the Israelite army—their fear turning to roaring, exultant victory, the sound of a thousand war cries echoing through the valley. They surge forward like a tidal wave, pursuing the fleeing Philistines.The camera slowly pushes back to David, standing alone in the center of the valley, the sword still in his hands, his face lifted to the heavens, his eyes filled not with pride, but with profound gratitude. The sun breaks through a gap in the clouds, casting a golden, divine light directly upon him. The valley is silent for one sacred moment. The young shepherd who trusted God, standing over the giant who trusted only in his own strength. A contrast of faith vs. arrogance. Divine power vs. human pride.FINAL SHOT:The camera slowly pulls upward, revealing the entire Valley of Elah. The fleeing Philistines. The pursuing Israelites. The dust rising from thousands of feet. And in the center, a single figure—a boy in a shepherd's tunic, standing over a fallen giant, a massive sword in his hands, his face turned toward heaven. The camera freezes on his silhouette against the golden sun. The battle belongs to the Lord. Faith has triumphed over fear.VISUAL STYLE:Ufotable masterpiece. Perfect character consistency. Dynamic camera movement. Volumetric lighting (divine golden light vs. harsh earthly shadow). Extreme contrast between size and faith. No magical energy trails. No glowing swords. No anime special effects. No fire. No destruction. Only the raw, cinematic power of biblical faith and divine intervention. Atmospheric. Epic. Reverent. Every frame reflects the spiritual battle described in 1 Samuel 17 and Elena G. de White's Patriarchs and Prophets. No text. No subtitles. No logos. No watermarks.

主題：
赤い壁と夏の横顔

人物・表情：
20代女性。明るいアイボリーベージュ寄りの白肌で、ほんのりピンクの血色を含んだ自然な肌質。頬、鼻先、肩、鎖骨に柔らかなハイライトが入り、過度な美肌補正ではなく繊細な肌理を残す。精密で上品なドールライク日系メイク、淡いローズピンクのチーク、シャンパンベージュとピンクブラウンのアイシャドウ、細く長いまつ毛、自然な涙袋、明るめブラウンの眉、透け感のあるピンクベージュのグロスリップ。瞳に小さく澄んだキャッチライト。表情は落ち着いていて、少しクールに遠くを見る。黒茶色の髪をゆるい低めポニーテールにまとめ、顔まわりに細い後れ毛が風で流れる。

服装・ポーズ：
夏らしい軽さのあるアイボリーの細ストラップリブニットキャミソール。鎖骨と肩のラインが自然に見えるが、露出は上品に抑える。ボトムスは生成りベージュのハイウエストワイドパンツ、リネン混の薄手素材で、ウエストに同色の長い布ベルトを結ぶ。足元はブラウンベージュの細ストラップサンダル。人物はテラコッタ色の低い壁の上に斜めに座り、人物自身の右手を壁の上に置いて体を支え、左膝を軽く立て、右脚は下へ自然に伸ばす。上半身は少し画面左へひねり、顔は青空側へ向ける。

背景・光：
日本の現代美術館や海沿いのモダンな屋上テラスのような、ミニマルな建築空間。赤茶のテラコッタ壁、低いパラペット、左側の大きな垂直壁、上部の薄い庇、奥に広がる澄んだ夏の青空。壁と床は細かなスタッコとコンクリートの質感を持つ。午後の強い太陽光が画面左上から差し込み、左壁に大きな斜めの影、人物の影を壁面に落とす。肩、頬、髪の縁に暖かい光が入り、影側は深く落ちるが、空からの青い反射光でわずかに持ち上げる。

構図・カメラ：
縦長3:4。中距離のファッションポートレート。人物は画面右寄りに配置し、上半分に広い青空の余白を残す。左側の赤い壁と斜めの影で強い幾何学構図を作る。人物の全身が入るが、画面下端はサンダル付近で少し余裕を残す。カメラはやや低めの目線、わずかな仰角。焦点は人物の顔と上半身、背景は浅すぎない自然な被写界深度。

質感・スタイル：
リアルな写真風AI画像。日本の夏のファッションエディトリアル、強い日差し、乾いた空気、テラコッタと青空の色面対比。肌は自然な質感、衣服はリネンとリブニットの織り目が見える。高コントラストだが硬すぎず、フィルム写真のような微細な粒子と落ち着いた色調。過度なHDR、過剰な美肌補正、アニメ調を避ける。

ネガティブ：
幼く見える顔、不自然な目線、過度な網紅メイク、プラスチックのような肌、露出過多、透ける服、余分または欠けた指、手足の融合、関節の破綻、座り姿勢の不自然さ、壁との接触不良、浮遊、光源と矛盾する影、誤った遠近法、不要な人物や小物、文字、ロゴ、透かし、参考画像の構図や服装をそのまま複製すること。

text:
You are a visual director for clinical biomorphic editorial realism.

Apply this style to any subject the user provides. The subject may be a person, animal, object, plant, building, room, landscape, garment, sculpture, machine, or abstract form. Do not copy surface motifs mechanically. Translate the deeper visual logic of the style into the subject.

The central idea is the conversion of a familiar subject into a cold, fragile, pale surface under close observation. The subject should feel quiet, exposed, and materially uncertain, as if it exists between body, sculpture, ash, porcelain, smoke, paper, bone, and mineral.

The image should not feel decorative. It should feel discovered. Avoid ornament for its own sake. Every mark, shadow, blur, stain, and texture must feel physically motivated by light, surface, atmosphere, pressure, residue, diffusion, or erosion.

Use a restrained desaturated palette. Favor cold white, bone white, chalk, ash grey, blue grey, diluted black, graphite, smoke, faint flesh pink, dry beige, and muted shadow tones. Color should feel drained from the image. Warmth may exist only as a faint biological trace, such as the edge of an eyelid, a lip, a thin membrane, a worn surface, or a small exposed undertone.

Treat the subject as a substrate. Its surface is the main field of meaning. Skin, fur, fabric, stone, glass, petals, walls, metal, paper, or water should appear tactile, pale, and vulnerable. Preserve pores, grain, fibers, cracks, dust, moisture, wrinkles, scratches, powder, or subtle irregularities when appropriate.

Introduce organic disturbance with restraint. This disturbance may appear as smoke diffusion, ink suspended under a surface, mineral branching, soft fungal bloom, shadow residue, burnt botanical trace, water stain, graphite bloom, frost vein, or ash carried by air. It must feel irregular, natural, and unstable. It must not look like a tattoo, logo, face paint, tribal pattern, fantasy marking, decorative filigree, random dirt, or horror wound.

Lighting is essential. Use cold directional daylight, pale reflected light, filtered window light, branch shadow, mesh shadow, lace shadow, glass distortion, or soft overcast exposure. Light should behave like an examiner. It should reveal texture, flatten color, cut through the subject, and create areas of blank whiteness. Shadows should feel organic and accidental, not theatrical.

Use close, intimate framing. Prefer fragments over complete explanation. A face may be reduced to eyes, lashes, cheek, ear, mouth, or skin. A flower may be reduced to petal surface and dark branching stain. A building may be reduced to white wall, window shadow, damp mineral marks, and cold air. A landscape may be reduced to fog, pale ground, black trees, and surface erosion. The frame should withhold context.

Emotion should be quiet, severe, and inward. The subject should not perform. Avoid dramatic expression, glamour posing, seductive framing, action, spectacle, and narrative clutter. The mood should feel suspended, clinical, intimate, fragile, and slightly inhuman without becoming monstrous.

Depth of field should be shallow when the subject allows it. Let edges fall away. Keep backgrounds minimal, blurred, grey, white, or cold toned. The image should feel close enough to touch but emotionally distant.

For portraits, suppress identity. Do not emphasize personality, charm, glamour, or conventional beauty. The face should become a surface of light, texture, and disturbance. Expressions should be neutral, lowered, absent, exhausted, sleeping, or quietly fixed. Eyes may be pale, wet, reflective, partially hidden, or shadowed. Lashes and fine hair may be sharply visible against overexposed skin.

For non human subjects, preserve the same grammar. Do not force human features onto them. Translate the style through material condition: pale surface, organic intrusion, cold light, close crop, tactile detail, quiet atmosphere, and withheld context.

Composition should feel controlled but not polished. Use asymmetry, partial obstruction, cropped forms, negative space, and surface rhythm. The strongest visual event should be the meeting point between pale material and dark organic disturbance.

Do not use generic quality language. Do not use phrases such as masterpiece, ultra detailed, best quality, cinematic, stunning, beautiful, trending, perfect, flawless, 8k, hyper realistic, or award winning. Describe concrete visual decisions only.

Do not add text, logos, captions, watermarks, decorative borders, interface elements, neon effects, colorful makeup, fantasy glow, glossy commercial lighting, symmetrical tattoos, skull makeup, gore, wounds, disease, monsters, or explicit sexual framing.

Always preserve the essence: a pale familiar subject made strange through cold observation, organic surface disturbance, invasive light, close framing, desaturated color, tactile texture, and emotional silence.

    ESSENCE: A subject rebuilt as a handcrafted layered-paper relief, set in a
   near-empty warm-white gallery frame — smooth matte planes against finely
   combed paper fiber, a few earthy Mediterranean accents, and soft shadows
   that betray every cut edge.
    MEDIUM: Layered paper-cut relief / quilled illustration / miniature diorama,
   photographed flat-on as a gallery piece. SHALLOW relief, never full 3D volume.
    MATERIALS: Heavy ivory cardstock, textured matte paper, thin stacked cuts,
   rolled quilling strips, folded tabs, hand-painted paper edges.
    CORE MOVE — translate textures into paper, don't render them realistically:
     smooth surfaces (walls, faces, bodies, sky, water) → clean matte planes, gently curved
     fur / hair / feathers   → dense parallel combed strips or fine incised grooves, following growth direction
     foliage / canopy        → granular quilled dots, torn-paper flecks, layered fringe
     fabric / drapery        → fanned vertical paper pleats
     smoke / cloud / flow     → curled, rolled quilling spirals
     fine detail (eyes, windows, hardware) → the smallest crisp cut-paper inlays — the ONLY sharp marks in the piece
   Keep the subject's silhouette, pose, and identity intact; only the material logic changes.
    TWO MODES (the reference uses both):
     (a) PORTRAIT — a single subject, centered or low on an empty white field, no environment.
     (b) DIORAMA  — the subject inside a sparse miniature scene built from the World Kit below.
   Both obey the same texture, color, light, and emptiness rules.
    FORM: Elegant simplified profiles stacked as shallow planes — thin, precise,
   visibly paper-made, with clean cut edges and soft curvature. No bulky toy volume.
   Readable across a room; rewarding up close.
    COLOR: ~90% warm white / ivory / cream. Accents used sparingly, ONLY as earthy
   Mediterranean notes — terracotta & brick-orange, dusty teal, sage & olive,
   ochre / mustard, muted red, warm brown. No neon, no heavy saturation, almost
   no black (shadow carries the contrast).
    LIGHT: Soft, diffuse, near-frontal studio light. Short, soft-edged drop shadows
   in the gaps BETWEEN layers — those shadows are the proof of construction.
   No drama, no rim light, no hard cast shadows.
    COMPOSITION: Aggressive negative space — leave 40–60% of the frame as quiet
   white paper, usually open above. Anchor the scene low on a single soft rolling
   cut-paper horizon. Place every element with restraint; let it breathe.
    WORLD KIT (for diorama mode): cubic whitewashed Mediterranean buildings,
   terracotta tile roofs, arched doors and shuttered windows, Italian umbrella
   pines and round shrub-balls on slim brown trunks, tiny walking figures (often
   one in red), a small dog, a stray rooftop tree or cat, an occasional bright
   umbrella or awning. Tiny scale, gentle human-scale narrative.
    FINISH: Matte, tactile, serene, refined — a quiet gallery photograph of a
   delicate, collectible paper installation. Poetic and faintly magical.
    AVOID: photorealism; clay / plastic / vinyl / metal / glass / plush logic;
   glossy surfaces; dark or cinematic lighting; hard outlines or comic linework;
   cluttered maximalism; thick chunky proportions; neon or high-saturation color;
